articleTitle: Customer Transaction Fraud Detection Using Xgboost Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Customer transaction fraud detection is an important application for both the public and banks and it is becoming a heated topic in research and industries. Many data mining techniques have been utilized in financial sys-tem to save consumers millions of dollars per year. In this study, we presented a Xgboost-based transaction fraud detection model with some feature engineering and visualization. The dataset is from IEEECIS Fraud Detection Competition on Kaggle, which is a well-informed data science organization. The study indicated that xgboost based model outperformed the other three methods including Support Vector Machine, Random Forest and Logistic Regression. As to two feature selection methods, Xgboost performed better. Our best model achieved 95.2% roc auc score on leader-board and defeated other 98 percent participants.

articleTitle: A Customer Churn Prediction Model Based on XGBoost and MLP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Customer churn prediction is one of the central data mining tasks for researchers. In recent years, the customer churn prediction based on neural networks has achieved great success. However, traditional DNNs cannot achieve great predictive performance when facing numerical features. Hence, we proposed a hybrid prediction model based on XGBoost and multi-layer perceptron (MLP). Contrary to DNNs, the prediction model based on tree structure is adept in manipulating numerical features. This model has two stages. In the first stage, the XGBoost is applied to export the leaf number of customers based on numerical features. Then the MLP is used to deal with the one-hot vector transformed from the leaf number and the original discrete features in the second stage. The experimental results showed that our proposed model has a better predictive performance.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical Attack Threats Analysis for UAVs from CPS Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have been widely adopted in military and civilian areas. However, security problems of UAVs are also gradually exposed and attracted great attention. As an integration of computation, control and communication components, UAVs could be considered as a typical Cyber Physical System (CPS). Therefore, the security threats coming from cyber-attack will affect the safety performance of UAVs, that is, cyber security threats could spread to physical domain. Aiming at the type of “cyber-physical attack”, this paper analyzes its main threats to UAVs from a CPS perspective. Based on analyzing CPS architecture of UAVs, the cyber-physical threats are clarified from attacks on sensors, computation/control, communication components respectively. As the preliminary work for analyzing cross-domain security risk propagation mechanism of UAVs, the spread process of the threats from cyber domain to physical domain was analyzed, which is also of reference significance for analyzing other CPS.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To solve the problem of low accuracy and low adaptability of traditional intrusion detection technology, we propose an intrusion detection algorithm based on convolutional neural network. In this paper, two convolution layers and pooling layers are used, and a batch normalization layer is added after each convolution layer to improve the speed of network and avoid mode collapse. During the experiment, SGD and Adam optimizers were used to train the model respectively. The results show that Adam optimizer has better performance. When epoch =200, the model precision average value can reach 0.9507, F1 average value can reach 0.9438.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Agriculture Service System With LoRa-based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In view of the current intelligent agriculture's collection and processing of production site data and the control requirements of related equipment, ZigBee, WiFi, GPRS traditional wireless sensing technology has short trans-mission distance and signal interference in greenhouse environment monitor-ing systems such as large-scale farms. shortcomings such as complex net-working, This work proposes a low-power farm environment detection system based on LoRa wireless technology. This model can use various sensors in the laboratory to complete the detection of soil and model environmental param-eters, and implement lighting control and irrigation control, cooling control and man-machine control. The designed system sleep current is as low as 0.3 $\mu$ A, the average working current, has the advantages of long transmission distance and low power consumption. After verifying the feasibility of the technology through an experimental model, the system was applied to a spe-cific greenhouse and data collection and analysis were completed.

articleTitle: Three Stream 3D CNN with SE Block for Micro-Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Micro-expression is a kind of short-term and imperceptible facial expression. In this paper, we propose a method of micro-expression recognition using SEnet and three-stream 3D CNN (SETFNet). Three different facial regions are used as the input of three streams. Adding SE block to the network can learn the weights of each feature channel adaptively. Experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the recognition performance of micro-expression.

articleTitle: Research of Innovative Business Classification in Bulk Commodity Digital Supply Chain Finance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traditional supply chain finance service needs to combine with the new information technology. Internet of Things and blockchain technology can have efficient effects on the supply chain management in bulk commodity. The paper makes research on its innovative business classification based on the blockchain digital platform. Based on OIPB, OARB, OAPB model, it uses the multiparty process analysis to discuss the key roles in the supply chain. And it shows that the digital platform will help to strengthen the ability to connect with the external systems and improve efficiency of online forensics.

articleTitle: Optimization of Information Retrieval Algorithm for Digital Library Based on Semantic Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The information retrieval of digital library has always been one of the major research topics in the field of library. The ranking of search results directly leads to the efficiency of readers searching for the information that they want to find. Now, there are mainly two general ranking algorithms based on semantic search engines (SSE), that are ranking algorithms for OntoKhoj and AKTiveRank. However, these are not ideal for two sorts of sorting results, which mainly due to the rather one-sided sorting idea; and the coefficients in the formula were difficult to determine. To solve this problem by combining the two algorithms advantages of OntoKhoj and AKTiveRank, a new algorithm, which named Mellom algorithm, was proposed, and its coefficients were optimized by applying genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: Instance Segmentation Based on Mask Scoring R-CNN for Group-housed Pigs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Pig instance segmentation is a challenging task for group-housed pigs in complex scenes due to variable light and pig's occlusion. In this paper, an instance segmentation approach based on Mask Scoring R-CNN framework is proposed to solve pig instance segmentation from complex backgrounds automatically. The proposed approach includes three steps: first, a CNN-based feature extraction, which uses backbone architecture with residual network of depth 101 layers (ResNet-101) and feature pyramid network (FPN) that can extract features from low-level and high-level of the feature pyramid according to different scales. Then, the candidate regions of interest (RoIs) are generated by region proposal network (RPN) based on the features derived from backbone architecture. Finally, we detect and segment the pig for each RoI. The proposed approach was trained and tested on dataset from front-view and top-view videos of pigs. The proposed approach achieved best F1 score of 0.9405. According to these experimental results, the approach can robustly detect and segment multiple target pigs under the group-housed pig natural scenes such as uneven illumination, pigs' occlusion and overlapping.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Classification: A DOA-Based Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Neural networks provide powerful tools to assist in the conventional field of signal processing. In this paper, to promote the capability of a microphone array in distinguishing acoustical signals from different locations, we extract the direction of arrival (DOA) information and perform the multi label classification based on deep learning. More specifically, by extracting the directional features from the generalized cross-correlation (GCC) vectors and assigning multiple labels to the estimated DOA, we transform the traditional DOA estimation problem into a multilabel classification problem. The transformed problem is further solved by applying a simple convolutional neural network (CNN). Experimental results on both real and simulated data show the validity and superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital Image Denoising Method Based on Mean Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Digital image processing refers to the use of computers for the digital processing of visual information in scientific research and production, and the processing of image information to meet people’s visual psychology or application needs. As an important medium and means to transmit information, image information is especially important in the information accepted by human beings. As a non-linear filtering method, mean filtering can not only eliminate random noise and impulse interference, but also retain image edge information to a large extent. After the emergence of digital image processing technology, people can use it to modify and beautify the image according to their own needs, which makes the image a collection of pixels. The traditional mean filtering method can not meet the real-time requirements well, and it will lose some image details while removing impulse noise. Combined with the block mean filtering method in the multi window structure of automatic recognition, it can better preprocess the image when it is relatively complex.

articleTitle: Application of PID Simulation Control Mode in Quadrotor Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A multi-rotor aircraft is an autonomous and reusable aircraft. It has the advantages of small size, simple structure, vertical take-off and landing, free hovering, and high flexibility, which has become a research hotspot in the field of drone applications. Based on a self-designed and integrated quad-rotor hardware, this paper uses STM32-based ARM flight control board as the core to derive the dynamic model of the quad-rotor in different coordinate systems. In the MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment, a complete quadrotor aircraft nonlinear control model is established in this paper. The quadrotor aircraft dynamics model and PID controller are connected in series to form a complete control system model. The experimental results show that the designed PID-based control method can realize the smooth control of the quadrotor aircraft.

articleTitle: Keyword Extraction Method for Complex Nodes Based on TextRank Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Keywords are important way for people to quickly understand content of document and grasp subject, and keyword extraction technology is significant way to quickly obtain core meaning of text information, which has wide range of applications in fields such as intelligence, journalism, information retrieval and natural language understanding. However, traditional TextRank algorithm refers to local co-occurrence relationship among text words, which does not pay much attention to complex network structure characteristics of word graphs. Therefore, structure of network is adjusted by removing nodes to separate sub-networks with layers. Moreover, taking into account complex network structure characteristics of word nodes, method of word node removal is introduced as well. Meanwhile, value of sliding window is increased so that ranking can be obtained through multiple iterations, and then one of the highest ranking keyword nodes will be removed in turn. Besides it, Keyword extraction is then performed on each subtopic where sub-keywords are determined based on ranking of candidate keywords, and key nodes of text network are added to sequence so that keyword extraction can be achieved, which achieves improvement of traditional TextRank algorithm, and accuracy, recall, and F value are all improved as well.

articleTitle: Classifying Packed Malware Represented as Control Flow Graphs using Deep Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, the variety and quantity of malware has increased rapidly, which makes classification based on fixed features very difficult. In order to better preserve the integrity of the malware, we extract the control flow graph of malware as the feature information. However, control flow graph of a packed malware consists of both unpack control flow graph and local control flow graph. In order to obtain a clean control flow graph, we analysis the packed malware dynamically and apply an algorithm to strip the unpacking routine from the graph. With the rapid development of Graph Neural Network (GNN), we use Deep graph Convolutional Network (DGCNN) to classify control flow graph data. Experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve 96.4% accuracy.

articleTitle: Miniature Water Surface Garbage Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In light of the problem for garbage cleaning in small water area, an intelligent miniature water surface garbage cleaning robot with unmanned driving and convenient operation is designed. Based on STC12C5A60S2 as the main controller in the design, power module, transmission module and cleaning module are controlled together to realize the function of cleaning and transporting garbage, intelligent remote control of miniature water surface garbage cleaning robot is realized by the WiFi module. Then the prototype is developed and tested, which will verify the rationality of the design. Compared with the traditional manual driving water surface cleaning devices, the designed robot realizes the intelligent control of unmanned driving, and achieves the purpose of saving human resources and reducing labor intensity, and the system operates security and stability, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: The Design of Seat for Sitting Posture Correction Based on Ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on Arduino development platform, a seat which can correct the wrong sitting posture is designed. The specific implementation method is to measure the distance difference between the human body and the seat back by using the ultrasonic sensor group installed on the seat back and the force distribution using the pressure sensor array installed on the seat surface. Combined with the physiological curvature of the human spine and the distribution of the body pressure under the sitting posture, it determines the sitting posture of the human body comprehensively, and generates an alarm signal to remind the user to change the bad sitting posture. The design idea of this kind of seat is based on the previous research and verified by real person experiment, which has certain practical significance and reference value.

articleTitle: Design of Industrial Internet of Things Gateway with Multi-source data Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The industrial internet of things is to integrate all kinds of acquisition or control sensors or controllers with sensing and monitoring capabilities, ubiquitous technology, mobile communication, intelligent analysis and other technologies into all aspects of the industrial production process, so as to greatly improve manufacturing efficiency, improve product quality, reduce product cost and resource consumption, and finally realize the new level of promotion from traditional industry to intelligence. However, it is difficult to realize the integration and sharing of data because of the complex control equipment and various communication protocols in the process control layer of industrial enterprises. This paper analyzes the multi-source heterogeneous data collection model, proposes a data collection system design scheme based on the gateway of the industrial internet of things, solves the key problem of multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition in the industrial field. And then this paper realizes the real-time collection of multi-source heterogeneous data in the industrial field, and provides high-value data for the whole production process for the application of industrial big data.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Voiceprint Recognition Model based DNN-RELIANCE
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The traditional voiceprint recognition model (Gaussian hybrid model, hidden Markov model) is very dependent on the scale of speaker speech. Higher recognition performance often requires a large number of trained speaker speech to achieve, and has such shortcomings as environmental noise sensitivity and long training time, besides, it is difficult in convergence, the application of voiceprint recognition in practice is limited accordingly. The deep neural network has the ability of autonomous learning, and it can extract the deep speaker speech features that are not sensitive to environmental noise according to the target, and the extracted speaker speech features can be well classified and identified with the powerful pattern classification ability. So the deep neural network (DNN) is used as the voiceprint recognition model in this paper. However, the experiment shows that the DNN-based voiceprint recognition system still has a low accuracy rate of rejection of counterfeiters. For this reason, the trust degree and label distance are introduced, and the two-order judgment structure based on DNN-RLIANCE algorithm is proposed. Experiments show that the algorithm has short training and recognition time but high recognition accuracy, especially the system's correct rejection rate for impostors is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Reconfiguration of Distributed Distribution Network Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the depletion of traditional energy sources and increasingly serious environmental pollution, distributed power has received more attention, and high-permeability distributed power participates in grid connection, which brings new challenges to power distribution network. Therefore, mathematical model for distribution network reconstruction with the minimum network loss as objective function is established in this paper where 4 different types of DG are connected to IEEE 33-node distribution system and reconstructed with the help of genetic ant colony algorithm. Moreover, in terms of precocity and local convergence of genetic algorithm, ant colony algorithm is added, and advantages of genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm at different stages are used to fuse the two to avoid algorithm's premature stagnation and falling into local optimum so that optimization ability and convergence speed of the algorithm can be improved.

articleTitle: Traceable Ciphertext Policy Attribute-based Encryption Scheme with User Revocation for Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Ciphertext policy Attribute-based encryption (CPABE) plays an increasingly important role in the field of fine-grained access control for cloud storage. However, The exiting solution can not balance the issue of user identity tracking and user revocation. In this paper, we propose a CP-ABE scheme that supports association revocation and traceability. This scheme uses identity directory technology to realize single user revocation and associated user revocation, and the ciphertext re-encryption technology guarantees the forward security of revocation without updating the private key. In addition, we can accurately trace the identity of the user according to the decryption private key and effectively solve the problem of key abuse. This scheme is proved to be safe and traceable under the standard model, and can effectively control the computational and storage costs while maintaining functional advantages. It is suitable for the practical scenarios of tracking audit and user revocation.

articleTitle: Construction of E-commerce Platform System for Targeted Poverty Alleviation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of agricultural informatization on China, e-commerce plays an increasingly important role in targeted poverty alleviation in rural areas. Poverty alleviation through e-commerce should be a sustainable work. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to strengthen the construction of rural e-commerce system and build a targeted poverty alleviation e-commerce platform system suitable for farmers, especially poor farmers. The e-commerce platform for targeted poverty alleviation consists of business architecture, trading platform, online trading, security traceability, production management of agricultural internet of things, etc. The combination of targeted poverty alleviation with e-commerce, agricultural production and online sales will build an ecommerce platform, which will help poor farmers get rid of poverty and become rich.

articleTitle: Short-term Traffic Flow Prediction Based on PCC-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Timely and accurate traffic flow information is essential for the realization of intelligent transportation systems (ITS). For the existing traffic flow prediction models, only the temporal features were extracted but the spatial features were neglects. A short-term traffic flow prediction model based on Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM) model was proposed. The PCC was used to mine the spatial dependence of the road network, and the temporal features of traffic flow were mined using BiLSTM model. The extracted temporal and spatial features were combined to achieve short-term flow prediction. The experimental results show that the PCC-BiLSTM model has higher prediction accuracy and lower error than the prediction models considering only temporal features, which verifies the effectiveness of traffic flow prediction in consideration of both temporal and spatial characteristics.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Canny Operator Edge Pre-processing Based on Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Mathematical morphology has great advantages in edge detection, and its edge detection accuracy is high. Mathematical morphology is a kind of method applied in the field of image processing and pattern recognition, which integrates multi-disciplinary knowledge, has strict mathematical theory as the basis, and is a kind of non-linear image processing theory. Therefore, based on mathematical morphological theory, various random interference signals such as noise caused by edge algorithm during image imaging, transmission, conversion or storage are processed in this paper. Moreover, combining Canny operators and mathematical morphology, morphological algorithms is first used to pre-process noise reduction, and then Canny detection is performed to more effectively filter out noise. What's more, after comparative testing and analysis with various algorithms, it is proved that noise suppression effect of the algorithm studied in this paper is significantly higher than other algorithms, which makes the application of mathematical morphology in edge detection more effective.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain News Production Based on Digital Encryption Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Blockchain technology provides a new logic for digital content production. At present, the Internet is a “one center, multi node” technology architecture. Blockchain constructs the underlying structure of “multi center, multi node”. The block chain's digital encryption, backtracking, distributed account book and time stamp can solve the problems that the network data is easy to tamper with and not easy to save. Meanwhile, it provide a new technical support for the verification of news data. On the basis of Hasche Algorithm, the information after user's signature and authorization can be disclosed in the network, which can ensure the security of user's personal information. On the other hand, the application of blockchain in the field of news production can reshape the trust mechanism between communicators and users. This study uses observation and induction to describe the application scenarios of blockchain technology in the media industry. The application of blockchain technology will change the existing mode of news production and distribution. Specifically, Based on the main chain and parallel chain of DAG account book, this study considers that blockchain technology has a strong application value in the fields of news copyright protection, news source verification, advertising traffic fraud control and so on.

articleTitle: Optimized Air Quality Prediction Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Air pollution is still the biggest factor jeopardizing environmental public health and safety. In fact, the model based on artificial intelligence research has been widely used in actual air quality prediction. However, for the special field of meteorology, the closeness of the prediction result from a single value (such as minimizing the root mean square error) does not necessarily indicate a good prediction effect, and the analysis of experimental results should be multifaceted. When building a model, it often encounters the occurrence of spatiotemporal instability, delay effects, overfitting, etc., which makes the prediction accuracy need to be improved. To overcome these bottlenecks. Based on the current research status of deep neural networks, this paper proposes a highly accurate air quality prediction model based on data mining. In terms of efficiency, combined with the complexity of the parameters in the meteorological field, a method based on the weighted limit learning machine (W-ELM) parameter learning is proposed. The weights of the input layer and the random assignment of the offset can be calculated. Learning speed has been greatly improved. In terms of accuracy, an algorithm combining sparse autoencoder (SAE) and swish activation function is proposed, which can greatly improve the prediction accuracy. Through experiments, it can be proved that the model has high fitting degree and low distortion rate, which can provide better reference value for air prediction research.

articleTitle: Research on Image Classification Method Based on DCNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Image classification is a kind of image processing technology, which can recognize different things by the feature information given by pictures. With the rapid development of science and technology and people's higher and higher demand for quality of life, image automatic classification technology has been applied to various fields of development. When we classify the image, the traditional image classification method can not accurately grasp the internal relationship between the recognition objects, and the traditional method also has the limitation of the recognition object's feature expression because of the too high characteristic dimension of the data, so the experimental results are not ideal. In view of the above content, this paper proposes an image detection method based on convolutional neural network. The experimental algorithm mainly refers to deep learning and convolutional neural network. Different from the traditional image classification methods, the deep convolution neural network model can be used for feature learning and image classification at the same time. By improving the structure of each part of the experiment and optimizing the convolution neural network model, the over fitting phenomenon can be prevented, and then the accuracy of image detection can be improved. The experiment on cifar-10 database shows that the improved deep learning model of this method has achieved effective results in image detection.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Technology in Urban Traffic Congestion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The phenomenon of urban traffic congestion has largely restricted the overall efficiency of the traffic planning control network. Traditional cities' road planning and traffic control facilities seem to be stretched in the face of the problem of high-traffic vehicle traffic. How to effectively alleviate and manage urban traffic congestion will affect the healthy and sustainable development of the domestic economy. Through the investigation and research of the existing intelligent technology, this paper mainly discusses how to apply the mature intelligent technology to the urban traffic planning and control system to alleviate the urban traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Research on Node Location Algorithm of Zigbee Based on optimized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: For the model parameters of RSSI signal intensity location algorithm in wireless sensor networks are susceptible to environmental impact, the positioning accuracy cannot meet the needs of high-precision indoor positioning in specific scenarios. This paper presents a Zigbee indoor location algorithm based on improved neural network optimization algorithm. Quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) is used to optimize the smooth parameters of the generalized neural network. The root mean square error between the predicted coordinates and the actual coordinates of the location node is selected to construct the fitness function. With the help of MATLAB software, the simulation comparison between the QPSO-GRNN localization algorithm and the non-optimized GRNN localization algorithm is established. The experimental results show that the average error of the non-optimized GRNN localization algorithm is 1. 0143m, and the average error of the QPSO-GRNN localization algorithm is 0. 5683m. The improved positioning algorithm has high accuracy, strong robustness and anti-jamming ability. Zigbee indoor positioning technology based on improved neural network optimization algorithm has high positioning accuracy and good stability, and has certain application value and development prospects.

articleTitle: Research on the main problems and countermeasures of Flipped Classroom in college teaching practice
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Compared with the traditional teaching mode, the flipped classroom teaching mode is an independent, flexible and innovative teaching mode with the help of more modern information technology. At present, flipped classroom teaching has become a new teaching mode, which changes the teaching order and teaching methods, provides students with a broader learning range and superior learning resources, and comprehensively improves students' comprehensive ability. Because the former teaching mode has been in the conservative system of the traditional mode for a long time, the education mode still has a certain degree of conservatism, as well as the later development and fracture of technology ecology. Therefore, the corresponding countermeasures are put forward, such as constantly innovating teaching ideas, paying attention to the changes of teaching structure, using modern information technology to establish a new mode of modern teaching, broadening students' deep learning ability, and creating a socialized knowledge construction mechanism, so as to achieve the teaching purpose. Based on the teaching mode and teaching resources, we will continue to explore the practice of China's flipped classroom reform, summarize experience, and lay the foundation for the follow-up development of flipped classroom. The research methods of this paper mainly include literature research, case study, interview, classroom observation and text analysis. The purpose of the study is to define the concept, characteristics and principles of flipped classroom teaching, analyze the theoretical basis for its generation, and sort out the development of flipped classroom teaching in China through literature analysis and related research on flipped classroom teaching; Take Ningbo University of Finance and economics as a case study, understand the problems in its teaching through text analysis and classroom observation, and analyze the problems indepth through interviews The reason, puts forward the corresponding solution countermeasure. articleTitle: Lighting Style and Color Temperature to Emotion Response in Architecture Illumination of the Historic Buildings in Dalian
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this study, this research was described to make better use of lighting design techniques and color light to display the unique charm of historic buildings in Dalian, and bring pleasant psychological feelings to people, has been the focus of attention in the field of lighting engineering and design. In this paper, typical architectural color samples are obtained through the color test of historic buildings. Three typical light sources are chosen for the simulation experiments of architectural landscape lighting. The measured architectural color samples are simulated and reconstructed through different lighting methods and light color lighting. The subjective emotional response of 12 lighting effects was evaluated, and research draw the preliminary conclusion based on the expression and response of color and light emotion of the architectural lighting design technique and correlated color temperature (CCT). Furthermore, the typical lighting design methods and different adaptability of variable light sources in landscape lighting are summarized to provide a strong scientific basis for the application of color lighting in historical architectural landscape lighting in the future.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Commercial Economic Index Based on BPNN Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, a prediction method of business economic index based on BP neural network (BPNN) optimization algorithm is proposed. The parameters of BPNN model are optimized by introducing genetic algorithm, and the optimized BPNN model is used to predict the business economic index and get the optimal value. In the experiment, the optimized BPNN model is applied to the prediction of total commercial output value and commercial power consumption, and compared with the traditional BPNN prediction model. According to the experimental results, the BPNN optimization model is more accurate in the judgment and prediction of the trend of business economic operation indicators, which can provide an effective basis for the business macro decision-making and promote the long-term healthy development of the commercial economy.

articleTitle: Research on Data Fusion Method Based on Rough Set Theory and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the basic theory of rough set and data fusion, a data fusion method based on the combination of rough set theory and BP neural network is studied. The rough set is used to simplify the input information and eliminate redundant information, which reduces the size of the BP neural network, improves the recognition rate of the fusion system, and then improves the efficiency of the entire fusion system. Compared with the traditional neural network fusion system, the effectiveness of the method is illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: Emotion Computing Method Based On Knowledge Representation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of traditional affective computing methods with low computational accuracy, a kind of affective computing method based on knowledge representation is proposed. This method is based on the introduction of knowledge representation. According to emotion node vector and emotion control vertex determination. The real number coding scheme is used to calculate the change of emotional parameters and emotional psychological state. Experimental data show that the accuracy of the proposed method is 39.5% higher than that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Cultural Gene Image Based on PCA Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Feature extraction technology is an important field in computer vision and image processing. It extracts the image information by using computer software, and then process these information appropriately. Finally, an image of the feature points and the corresponding feature values will be got. This paper introduced the main principles of the PCA feature extraction method, and analyzed the advantages of feature extraction in the study of cultural genes. Matlab software was used to carry out the experiments of feature extraction and recognition on the Miao costume image cultural gene data set. The effects of using original image recognition and feature extraction were compared. In final, effectiveness of the algorithm was verified and the significance of feature extraction technology in the study of cultural gene was proved.

articleTitle: “Internet + Internship Management”: College Internship Management Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Internship is a core step in talent training in colleges and is related to knowledge increase and quality development of students. In teaching practice, colleges should consider how to give better play to the teachers' roles, how to solve the problems of ineffective communication and mismanagement in internships. “Internet+ higher education”, “big data + education management” and other new concepts emerge, providing new inspirations for optimization of internships. This paper analyzes the “Internet + internship management” model from the perspective of building an internship management network platform, relying on the internship management platform to focus on student professional growth, teacher-student communication and student employment, and formulating a scientific incentive system.

articleTitle: A Meta-heuristic Test Case Prioritization Method Based on Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Software testing is an important and complex part of the software development life cycle. Along with version changes and defect repairs of the software system under test, regression testing is required to ensure that the modified parts have no impact on the unmodified parts. In a resource-constrained environment, it is necessary to select a more valuable test case from the test case library to execute first. However, the existing prioritization methods of test cases are still insufficient in terms of Average Percentage of Faults Detected (APFD) and time execution performance, and there is a problem of large search space. Aiming at the test case priority ranking problem, this paper proposes a meta-heuristic test case prioritization method based on a hybrid model to reduce test cost. This method first establishes a hybrid model by using the correlation between test cases and the importance of test data, and then uses an improved firefly algorithm based on the hybrid model to find an optimal test sequence. This article has carried out experiments on three benchmark test programs. The test suite is from Software-artifact Infrastructure Repository (1SIR). The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has better performance in terms of APFD and time execution compared with existing methods, such as Greedy, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Firefly Algorithm (FA).

articleTitle: A Research of GcForest Methods for Network Abnormal Behavior Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the age of Internet, information security has received more and more attention, and network abnormal behavior detection technology has emerged as the times require. Aiming at the lack of accuracy and flexibility of traditional abnormal behavior detection technology in detecting multi-class malicious behaviors, this paper proposes a network abnormal behavior detection technology based on gcForest. The compareson through experiments proves that the technology has obvious advantages in the field of network abnormal behavior detection.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Localization Learning Platform Based on Blended Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Blended learning for combination online with offline cannot be inseparable from the support of localization learning platforms. Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) are not suitable for blended learning because of insufficient functions of management and monitoring offline learning activities on campus. The research presents the user permission for functions of a localization learning platform based on blended learning from the user requirement and describes the functionality design from the technology for implementation. A localization learning platform of AHMOOC in Chuzhou University is designed and applied for blended learning as an application case, and significant effect is obtained. Furthermore, further work is put forward. Firstly, unified external interface for other application systems should be designed to integrate with the localization learning platform under the background of smart campus. Secondly, personalized learning resource based on integrable ware should be designed and reused on localization learning platform for blended learning.

articleTitle: Patch-based Generative Adversarial Network for Single Image Haze Removal
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Image haze removal is widely used in various fields and is an important link to improve the ability of image recognition under special circumstances. In order to improve the image haze removal level, this paper proposes a single image haze removal method based on network image translation (Pix2Pix). Relying on the encoder-decoder model and the Markov Discriminator (PatchGAN), it is possible to maintain a high resolution and texture structure of the image while defogging. Finally, experiments on synthetic prove that this algorithm is better than others in objective indicators of PSNR and SSIM.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Hybrid Teaching Based on AI technology for Foreign Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the context of AI technology, it is necessary to reform the education by adopting information technology and intelligent teaching tools. The hybrid teaching and learning based on AI technology integrates online teaching with offline classroom teaching, by taking advantage of both informatic teaching and traditional teaching. This study takes an example of Japanese translation course of junior students majoring in Japanese language in higher education institutions, and conducts the AI-based Japanese translation hybrid teaching practice. The results indicate that the AI-based hybrid teaching mode may motivate students’ activity and self-discipline in learning, and increase their capability and motif of autonomous learning.

articleTitle: Multisim simulation and hardware implementation of intermittent oscillation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, the causes, process and conditions of intermittent oscillation are analyzed for capacitor three-point circuit. The Multisim simulation of the Clapp oscillator was carried out and the corresponding hardware was built. We analyze the influence of quality factor of oscillation circuit, bypass capacitance of self-biased branch and resistance on intermittent oscillation through the control variable method. Then we compare the difference between the simulation image and the actual image, analyze the reason and the solution, and realize the process of intermittent oscillation from simulation analysis to practice.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Artificial Intelligence Development on Employment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence has developed rapidly and gradually integrated into all aspects of citizen life. The development of artificial intelligence has not only promoted the transformation and upgrading of the economy and society, but also has a huge impact on the employment structure. This article sorts out the development process of artificial intelligence, summarizes the impact of artificial intelligence on employment, and then proposes measures to deal with the impact of artificial intelligence on employment.

articleTitle: Research on Agent Control Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The control algorithm of the agent is an important research area of artificial intelligence, which reflects the way the agent completes tasks in a dynamic environment. Reinforcement learning is an advanced agent learning algorithm, which makes decision learning through the interaction between the agent and the dynamic environment, improves the strategy after repeated experiments, and finally gets the optimal action plan. In this paper, the PUMA560 robotic arm is selected as the agent body for simulation experiment research. In order to design a high-precision, low-error, fast-control robotic arm control method, we use Webots simulation software as a platform, use image-based visual servoing control algorithms, and use reinforcement learning algorithm Q-learning as the basis to improve and optimize control method.

articleTitle: Research on Data Center Operation and Maintenance Management Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the era of big data, data has become a new factor of production. During the operation and maintenance of the data center, rich operation data have been accumulated. How to effectively manage, analyze and mine the massive data accumulated in the operation and maintenance process, solve the problems that cannot be solved by automatic operation and maintenance, improve the fine management level of data center, and enable data center to better provide services for oilfield enterprises and users will become the challenge faced by oilfield data center in the era of big data. Taking “design and implementation of operation and maintenance log analysis system” as an example, this paper introduces the use of big data technology for further analysis and mining of operation and maintenance data, which is helpful to discover new value points, improve operation and maintenance initiative, and provide reference for fine operation and maintenance management of data center.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Shoulder Bending Defects in Tire X-ray Images
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The quality of tire determines the stability of vehicles. Among the various defects of tires, shoulder bending is a common and serious one. A novel method for shoulder bending detection in tire X-ray images is introduced in this paper. Firstly, a series of pre-processing operations including image inpainting, image blurring, adaptive binarization and image segmentation will be done on the images. Then a seed based cords searching algorithm is proposed to find the cords in pixel level. Finally, a feature extraction algorithm is designed to extract the feature vector of each cords which will be fed into the final judgement. In contrast with deep learning methods, the proposed solution does not require many samples to train the network and it is more adaptable when processing images produced from the factory assembly lines. Experimental results show that when processing different types of tire X-ray images, our method is not only more robust but also with even better precision and recall.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Ubiquitous Internet of Things Based on Pilot Classen Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, with explosive growth of cloud computing, high-definition video, artificial intelligence and ubiquitous Internet of Things network services, people urgently need more bandwidth resources and better network service quality are urgently required. Therefore, communication system for π/4DQPSK modulation method is proposed in this paper where FFT is performed on preamble to detect signal and estimate frequency offset with special preamble, which is simple and easy to implement. However, in actual communication, effects of sudden interference and noise need to be considered. Based on it, appropriate improvements are made, and preamble is divided into multiple zero-filling. Besides it, frequency offset is calculated through multiple fast Fourier transforms, and frequency offset estimation results are sorted. What's more, difference is filtered to remove larger deviation, and average estimation results of remaining frequency offset are used as final estimation result to reduce impact of sudden interference.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Elasticsearch for Media Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, a lot of information and data are generated rapidly in the process of using computers, and the amount of data also presents an explosive growth. Traditional relational databases such as mysql are gradually unable to meet the needs of users for quick retrieval. But Elasticsearch makes up for this slow retrieval by providing users with a quick way to do it. Therefore, in this paper, we use the Flask framework in python to write a system for rapid retrieval and visualization of media data. Firstly, a nonrelational database like MongoDB was used to store the raw media data we crawled from the network. Then import the data into the cluster set up by Elasticsearch, create a map of the data, add a Chinese word segmentation parser, and set up an inverted index, so that the data can be used to accurately retrieve information in the future. At the same time, Kibana can be used to visually display and present the data.

articleTitle: Research on the Back Propagation Neural Network Haze Prediction Model Based on Particle Swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The haze prediction model based on the BP neural network is feasible, but due to the BP neural network itself, the predicted value of the prediction model has a large error. In order to improve the accuracy of the haze prediction model based on BP neural network, a particle swarm optimization algorithm was proposed to optimize the haze prediction model based on BP neural network. The weights and thresholds of the haze prediction model based on BP neural network were optimized by the particle swarm algorithm to improve the accuracy of the prediction value. Under the same conditions as the data sample, haze prediction model based on basic BPNN neural network and haze prediction model based on BP neural network optimized by the particle swarm optimization algorithm were constructed separately. And both models have performed simulation experiments. The experimental results showed that the haze prediction model based on BP neural network optimized by the particle swarm optimization algorithm has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of RF temperature measurement system of delay linear SAW temperature sensor based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The delay line SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) temperature sensor is a kind of wireless passive temperature sensor. The sensor uses the RF antenna to receive the RF signal to excite the internal IDT, thus forming SAW signal on the surface of piezoelectric substrate material. The three reflectors inside the sensor successively reflect the SAW signal to the IDT; finally, the IDT transmits the reflected signal back through the RF antenna. According to the characteristics of SAW temperature sensor, a set of temperature measurement system is made. The hardware and software of the temperature measurement system are designed, so that the whole temperature measurement system can measure the temperature between 25 °C and 130 °C, and the temperature measurement error is required to be less than 1 °C.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Path Selection Based on Hybrid Genetic-Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Airport information weak current system is the core of airport terminal, which is responsible for information interaction, power resource and energy consumption management among subsystems of airport terminal. Meanwhile, it is also responsible for main business dispatch management of entire airport terminal. Therefore, starting with basic ant colony algorithm and considering respective advantages of genetic and ant colony algorithms, optimization cycle of the two algorithms is introduced multiple times in this paper. Moreover, after each loop iteration of ant colony algorithm, optimal solution generated by ant colony algorithm will be added to genetic algorithm so that iterative speed of genetic algorithm can be accelerated. Meanwhile, solution calculated by genetic algorithm will be set to better path to update pheromone allocation in ant colony algorithm and achieve parameter adjustment. Experimental test proves that geneticant colony hybrid algorithm proposed in this paper has good convergence and solution efficiency, which can find the shortest path with suitable conditions in complex road networks.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of RF Temperature Measurement Transceiver System Based on Delayed Linear SAW Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This article first studies the working principle of a wireless passive SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) temperature sensor. The pulse query signal is used to excite the sensor. After the sensor is excited, it returns the pulse signal reflected by each reflector. By measuring the phase difference of the pulse signals returned by the reflectors inside the sensor, the temperature of the sensor is estimated by the phase difference. The measurement scheme is given according to the principle of the sensor, and a matching RF temperature measurement system is designed based on the FPGA as the main control chip. The test results show that the temperature measurement system designed in this paper has a temperature measurement range of $25^{\circ}\mathrm{C}-130^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, a measurement error of $0.6^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, and a wireless signal transmission distance between the measurement system and the SAW temperature sensor is 100mm.

articleTitle: Research On Mybatis Mapper Model Based On SQL Template
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This article researches the implementation of Mybatis and the idea of SQL template design, analyzes the design idea of the persistence layer framework to solve the “impedance mismatch”, and analyzes the question of low development efficiency caused by the imperfection of mapper model in the current popular Mybatis persistence layer framework. Based on the framework Mybatis, this article combines operators to design a more complete mapper model, and designs a two-way synchronization mechanism for the SQL template for the model, which avoids problems such as the difficulty of late optimization caused by the strong coupling of operators and SQL. This model avoids redundant configuration files, while reducing optimization costs and improving flexibility and applicability through a twoway synchronization mechanism.

articleTitle: Security design of ECG telemonitoring systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) telemonitoring systems are a flourishing application of Wireless Body Area Networks (WBAN) in the field of healthcare. Due to inherent technical vulnerabilities and limitations of wireless systems, security and privacy threats are main areas of concern. To meet security and privacy requirements of ECG telemonitoring, an elaborate security design scheme is proposed. Firstly, Multi-stage Security Authentication (MSSA) strictly identifies all components and operators in the system, guaranteeing the legitimacy of the whole system. The next step is to ensure the security of all communications. High-intensity AES-256 algorithm and dynamic two-way keys are adopted to realize the security of public communications. A selective encryption mechanism provides a simple and effective security solution for local communications within the WBAN. To protect data from being falsified and ensure the correctness of data transmission, SHA-256 algorithm is used to verify the integrity of data. Finally, Authority Access Mechanism (AAM) based on smart cards is proposed to realize secure storage and access of sensitive data. Experimental results show that all security issues in the system are eliminated, and the system has very high security.

articleTitle: Research on the construction technology of college students’ thought and behavior guidance system based on 5G environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Along with the large data, cloud computing, chain blocks, such as the rapid development of information technology, Internet thinking also exist in its unique properties, morphology and operation mode indicates a newer way of thinking of brewing and formation, it is no longer limited to Internet product or Internet companies, but gradually evolved into a whole ecosystem to re-examine the way of thinking, and constantly affects people's behavior patterns. The exploration and construction of 5G mobile communication network technology in various countries is proceed at a high speed. Now, we are experiencing a great “transformation” in the industrial era + Internet era. Internet thinking is in big data, cloud computing, AI etc. New technology, the product to the market, users, filling a plan as a whole way of thinking, the current college students' thought and behavior guide work in colleges and universities is an important direction to embrace the Internet, using the Internet thought, be based on the thinking of college students' thought and behavior guide, Internet makes the Internet in the process of ideological and political education play a greater advantage and energy, education workers in colleges and universities is an urgent need to complete the task [1]. From a new visual Angle, “5 g” based on Internet thinking of college students' thought and behavior guide as the research object, system research based on the Internet the thought “environment construction, platform construction, content construction, team construction,” four one of the construction of the college students' thought and behavior guidance system, provides new train of thought for the development of college students' thought and behavior guide, promote the development of ideological and political education in the age of the Internet. The research on the guidance of college students' thoughts and behaviors based on Internet thinking can not only deepen the theoretical research of online ideological and political education in colleges and universities, but also put forward Suggestions for better practice of online ideological and political education in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: A New Network Security Architecture Based on SDN / NFV Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The new network based on software-defined network SDN and network function virtualization NFV will replace the traditional network, so it is urgent to study the network security architecture based on the new network environment. This paper presents a software - defined security SDS architecture. It is open and universal. It provides an open interface for security services, security devices, and security management. It enables different network security vendors to deploy security products and security solutions. It can realize the deployment, arrangement and customization of virtual security function VSFs. It implements fine-grained data flow control and security policy management. The author analyzes the different types of attacks that different parts of the system are vulnerable to. The defender can disable the network attacks by changing the server-side security configuration scheme. The future research direction of network security is put forward.

articleTitle: The Development of Artificial Intelligence Technology And Its Application in Communication Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has been widely used in industries such as smart manufacturing, medical care and home furnishings. Among them, the value of the application in communication security is very important. This paper makes a further exploration of the artificial intelligence technology and its application, and gives a detailed analysis of its development, standardization and the application.

articleTitle: A Steganography Algorithm Based on GM Model of optimized Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the concealment of image steganography, a new method is proposed. The algorithm firstly adopted GM (1, 1) model to detect texture and edge points of carrier image, then embedded secret information in them. GM (1, 1) model of optimized parameters can make full use of pixels information. These pixels are the nearest to the detected point, so it improves the detection accuracy. The method is a kind of steganography based on human visual system. By testing the stegano images with different embedding capacities, the result indicates concealment and image quality of the proposed algorithm are better than BPCS (Bit-plane Complexity Segmentation) and PVD (Pixel-value Differencing), which are also based on visual characteristics.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things Information Security Transmission Based On PBFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the security problems such as data theft, fraud and tampering in the information transmission process of the Internet of things, this paper studies the decentralized and trustless technology of Internet of things information transmission based on the blockchain technology through the super ledger Fabric blockchain platform, and proposes a technology for Internet of things transmission information security that uses the PBFT algorithm. Simulation results show that the algorithm effectively utilizes the redundant computing power in the network and improves the security of information transmission and fault tolerance of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Vehicle Scheduling Optimization Based on Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to eliminate waste in the process of logistics and transportation, and improve the timeliness and accuracy of logistics and distribution, the information physics system, Cyber-Physical System, or CPS system, is used to dispatch urban logistics vehicles. The CPS system integrates system engineering, such as context-awareness for the environment, embedded computing, network communication and network control, calculation, communication, precise control and remote collaboration based on the perception and perception of surrounding objects by surrounding objects. A series of data such as the location of the logistics decentralized point, the flow of the vehicle, the vehicle load, and the travel distance of the vehicle are uploaded to the database through the network, and the ant colony algorithm is used for data analysis, which reduces the logistics distribution cost. Finally, the task is distributed to various logistics vehicles through the mobile phone, and the data flows in real time to the CPS system. This paper combines the path optimization between a three-level city logistics distribution center and distribution point to carry out an example analysis. The analysis results show that the optimization effect combined with ant colony algorithm is very obvious.

articleTitle: An Automatic Test Data Generation Method for Microservice Application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The microservice architecture is the new generation of distributed software system architecture. The traditional testing approach, in which test cases are created manually, is not sufficient to meet the testing requirements of a microservice application. In this paper, an automatic test data generation method is proposed. Firstly, the extended service interface description file is designed to improve the expression ability of interface. Next, according to the different complex types of parameters, the main procedure, key technologies and implementation methods of the test data generation are presented. Furthermore, an improved pairwise algorithm is described especially for the combined parameter so as to reduce the count of test data. Finally, the experiments prove that this method is feasible and effective. In conclusion, this research is helpful to improve the test efficiency, achieve effective management and enhance the software test ability of the SGCC (State Grid Corporation of China).

articleTitle: A Moving Target Defense Technology Based on SCIT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Moving target defense technology is one of the revolutionary techniques that is “changing the rules of the game” in the field of network technology, according to recent propositions from the US Science and Technology Commission. Building upon a recently-developed approach called Self Cleansing Intrusion Tolerance (SCIT), this paper proposes a moving target defense system that is based on server switching and cleaning. A protected object is maneuvered to improve its safety by exploiting software diversity and thereby introducing randomness and unpredictability into the system. Experimental results show that the improved system increases the difficulty of attack and significantly reduces the likelihood of a system being invaded, thus serving to enhance system security.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Smart Campus Social Platform Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In view of the shortage of resources and low utilization rate of resources in the campus, relying on advanced technologies such as big data, cloud computing and the Internet of things, the smart campus social platform is designed and developed, and deployed on the cloud server to provide real-time information release, campus dynamic understanding and resource sharing in the campus. In order to build a "clean" and "harmonious" campus website, the platform uses prefix tree algorithm to filter sensitive words. In the process of platform design, the problem of interface blocking or even downtime is solved by asynchronous processing. The platform uses Solr search engine to realize document storage and full-text search. The test results show that the platform has strong stability, shortens the search time, and provides convenience for teachers and students.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Recognition Method Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for remote sensing image recognition based on Faster R-CNN. Using Faster R-CNN model and ZFNet as the basic network, experiments show that the accuracy rate of Architecture, Greenhouses and Paddy field recognition is 90.67%, 93.85%, 83.33%, and the average recognition accuracy reached 89.28%. At the same time, compared with the recognition results of recognition detection methods such as CNN and TT-RICNN, it was found that the proposed Faster R-CNN model has better recognition performance well, with good recognition detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Level of detail optimization for real-time terrain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Terrain rendering is widely used in urban planning, geographic information system, virtual reality, 3D landscape, 3D game and other fields. This paper studies the terrain optimization based on the level of detail technology, which can reduce the geometric complexity of terrain data, improve the rendering speed of terrain without affecting the user's visual effect.

articleTitle: Multi-level Rasch Model Analysis of Computer-assisted Automated Scoring of English Listening and Speaking Tests
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The present study uses FACETS, a many-facet Rasch model measurement computer program, to explore the differences in rater severity and consistency among computer automatic scoring and 15 expert raters' rating on 215 examinees' speaking records derived from a mock examination of the Computer-based English Listening-Speaking Test (Guangdong). It finds that the rater severity differences among computer automatic scoring and expert raters' rating do not exert decisive influences on examinees' score distribution. The low bias rate of computer automatic scoring indicates that computer automatic scoring is better than human raters in terms of inner-consistency.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Simulation Platform for Medical Rehabilitation Robot Prosthesis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This thesis develops a robotic arm's interactive simulation platform. The main research method is to build an interactive simulation platform for robotic arms based on OpenGL virtual prototype technology and robot kinematics, and integrating Visual C ++ MFC program framework. The platform can accurately simulate the working performance of a medical rehabilitation robot arm, calculate the forward and inverse kinematics data, and end trajectory of the robot arm in real time, and realize 3D virtual simulation, human-computer interaction and virtual teaching of the medical rehabilitation robot arm. After testing, it was concluded that based on the simulation experimental platform technology, the accuracy of the kinematics algorithm of the robot arm was quickly verified, and the structural parameters of the robot arm were modified to optimize the structural design. It also provides a feasible verification platform for robot arm trajectory planning and demonstration.

articleTitle: The Change Law of Horizontal and Vertical Loss
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: According to the survey data on Pb in Jiaozhou Bay in May and August 1991 and the horizontal and vertical matter content change model put out by the author, the horizontal loss, vertical dilution and vertical accumulation of Pb surface content were calculated. And a model block diagram of the horizontal and vertical changes in Pb content was determined. Therefore, in May and August, the absolute loss amount of Pb content in the surface layer and the bottom layer varies from 1.12 to 13.81 μg/L, and the relative loss amount of the surface layer and the bottom layer Pb content ranges from 16.74 to 73.31%. The bottom content of Pb table has an absolute vertical dilution of 0.83-9.31μg/L, and its relative vertical dilution is 4.64-58.18%. The content of the bottom layer of the Pb table has an absolute vertical accumulation of 1.30 μg / L, and its relative vertical accumulation amount is 23.33%. In May and August, in the waters from the northern part of the Bay mouth through the bay to the center of the bay, the horizontal loss of Pb surface layer content was relatively high, reaching 43.61-73.31%, and the horizontal loss of Pb bottom layer content was relatively low, reaching 16.7437.47%. The variation of the amount of horizontal loss reveals that the Pb content only passes through the waters in the bay. In May and August, the waters from the northern part of the mouth of the bay through the bay to the center of the bay caused a relatively high level of surface loss and a relatively low level of bottom loss. The amount of surface level loss of Pb content is relatively high, and the amount of bottom level loss of Pb content is relatively low. The amount of surface level loss of Pb content is relatively high, and the amount of bottom level loss of Pb content is relatively low. The variation of the vertical loss amount reveals that when the surface Pb content of the water body changes from 16.00 μg/L to 4.27 μg/L, the vertical dilution amount of the bottom layer content of the Pb table changes to 28.33%. When the surface Pb content of the water changed from 31.66 μg/L to 17.85 μg/L, the vertical dilution of the Pb surface underlayer content changed from 14.02% to 4.64%. Humans need a large number of ships for maritime transport, and seawater containing lead (Pb) appears at the ship's dock. In this way, humans have continued Pb emissions to the marine environment, causing Pb pollution in the waters around the ship's wharf. As a result, Pb is brought to the surface layer of the seawater, and during the vertical migration process, the water is passed from the surface layer to the seabed [1-6]. Therefore, using the horizontal substance content change model and the vertical matter content change model proposed by the author, the horizontal migration process and vertical sedimentation process of Pb in Jiaozhou Bay waters were demonstrated by using the survey data on Pb content in Jiaozhou Bay in May and August 1991. The pollution process and pollution degree of Pb from water transport from ship docks are described, which provides a scientific basis for the study of vertical sedimentation and horizontal migration of Pb in the surface and bottom waters.

articleTitle: A Large Misalignment Angle Initial Alignment Method of SINS Based on Strong Tracking Sparse Grid Gauss Hermite filter
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The large misalignment angle error model of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) is a kind of nonlinear Gauss error model. The Gauss Hermite method can approach Gauss integral with any precision, and achieve high precision filtering effect. The number of Gauss Hermite integral points is exponentially related to the dimension of nonlinear system. In the process of real-time filtering, a large number of integral points of multidimensional system may lead to dimension disaster. According to the initial alignment error model of SINS with large misalignment angle, this paper presents a strong tracking reduced dimension sparse grid Gauss Hermite filtering method, which reduces the nonlinear integration dimension through separation of the linear and nonlinear terms, further reduces the number of Gauss hermit filtering integration points by sparse grid method, and ensures the stability of the system by strong tracking method.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Remote Monitoring System for Mechanical Vibration
