publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduces a wireless remote monitoring system for mechanical vibration, which is designed by using embedded technology and ZigBee technology. The system transplants the core of processor S3C2410 to embedded FTP server and boa server (called embedded dual server) for data collection and remote monitoring. Mechanical vibration data is collected and transmitted to double servers through ZigBee network, and all the data can be accessed remotely through the Internet. The paper introduces all the details of the design, and the comparison experiment shows that the system can effectively realize the collection remote and monitoring of mechanical vibration data.

articleTitle: Case Study of How to Help Manufacturing Enterprises Obtain Loan Through Supply Chain Documents on Blockchain Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Recent years, it has produced one trend to update the traditional business with the developing internet thinking and technology. In order to build the industrial ecosphere, which can attract more related partners, many companies try to push the layout of the bulk supply chain platform based on blockchain technology. The papers studies how to make full use of supply chain documents in digital assets. Based on risk and economic analysis, it makes research on the key points in the processes and provides the control measures to push the project innovation in order to help enterprises to obtain loan. At last, it compares the differences before and after the implementation. It shows the validity of receipts, storage and industry finance effectiveness can be further improved after implementation.

articleTitle: Research on Plateau Transmission Channel Patrol Technology Based on High Resolution Satellite Image Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous progress of the west to East power transmission project, the scale of the transmission line network in the plateau region continues to expand, but due to the influence of the plateau climate conditions, the difficulty of the inspection of the transmission channel in the plateau region gradually increases. In order to improve the inspection accuracy and efficiency of the plateau transmission channel, the worldview-3 high-resolution satellite image data is used in this paper. The multi-scale segmentation technology and object-oriented classification algorithm are adopted to study and analyze the extraction method of key ground feature information of the transmission channel on the plateau. The result shows that the object-oriented algorithm is applicable to the information extraction of high-resolution image data, and the inspection of transmission channel based on high-resolution satellite image technology is feasible. The accuracy of shed information extraction can reach 95% by multi-scale segmentation technology coupled with object-oriented classification algorithm, which can replace manual interpretation work. The accuracy of road information is relatively low, but it can still replace most of manual interpretation work. Compared with traditional field inspection and manual visual interpretation, multi-scale segmentation technology coupled with object-oriented classification algorithm has the advantages of high boundary precision and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Quantum calculation on zero-point vibration energy of solid argon
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the first principles, using the many-body expansion theory and Hartree-Fock SCF method, we calculate the relations among the zero-point vibration energy and atomic displacement of deviating from the equilibrium position, vibration frequency, molar volume of fcc solid argon in the atomic distance of 2.3-4.0Å, then obtain the Gruneisen coefficient and the zero-point vibration pressure. It is included that the motion of atoms around equilibrium positions can be thought as approximate harmonic vibration. The larger the molar volume of solid argon is, the greater the vibration frequency and zero-point vibration energy are. With the increase of the molar volume, Gruneisen coefficient increase, while the zero-point vibration pressure decrease.

articleTitle: A Modified MODE-TOEP Algorithm for Estimating Coherent Signals DOA on Uniform Circular Array
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, an improved MODE-TOEP algorithm for direction-of-arrival estimation of coherent signals is proposed based on uniform circular array. The output data after mode space transformation can be used to reconstruct a Toeplitz matrix, and the correlations between this Toeplitz matrix and any two received data are obtained. After Hermitian transpositing and forward and backward smoothing, the equivalent sample matrix is transformed to a Hermitian matrix for DOA estimation of coherent signals, which solves the problem that the MODE-TOEP is used incomplete information by constructing only one Toeplitz matrix. The simulation results verify that the proposed algorithm has a better estimation performance and probability of resolution than the MODE-TOEP method.

articleTitle: An Electric Fire Flame Detection Algorithm Based on Temporal Convolution
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Flame detection algorithm is very important in electric power fire prevention. In order to solve the problems of insufficient generalization force, high false alarm rate and poor adaptability of flame detection algorithm, a power video flame detection algorithm based on temporal convolution, which integrates TCML (Temporal-Convolution-based meta-learner) and FHOG (Fused Histogram of Oriented Gradient). The candidate region set was determined by particle filter, and FHOG feature was extracted; Abstract features are extracted with TCML; The distance between features was determined by using the kelley-klein metric learning criterion, and the flame was identified. The experimental results show that the proposed flame detection algorithm has high accuracy, good image fusion and generalization ability, and strong adaptability to the environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Fall Detection System Based on Video
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and stability, a doublealgorithm fall detection system is designed. OpenPose and threshold determination are used as algorithm #1 to detect falls, while two neural networks splicing are used independently as algorithm #2 for cross-check. Compared to OpenPose or 3DCNN model alone, the result shows higher F1 and more accurate and pragmatically valuable. A real-time fall detection system is designed based on the study of algorithm #1 and #2. The history data analysis module is added to store and analyze the keyframes of falls, the images of which would be desensitized to protect users' privacy. A valuable reference model is hereby provided for future products in the potential market.

articleTitle: Overview of Fractionated Spacecraft Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The fractionated spacecraft technology, which decomposes the traditional integrated satellite into several functional modules according to the functional differences, with the characteristics of low mission cost, high performance, high reliability and high survivability, is now the hot spot of aviation research in various countries. Based on the fractionated spacecraft architecture design, this paper summarizes the key technologies of fractionated spacecraft, and analyzes the typical applications, which has certain reference value for the development of fractionated spacecraft technology in China.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Application of complex skill Learning based on TPACK Theory and 4C/ID Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Complex skills refer to the comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills that students have learned in the process of learning, but the students' performance is poor in practice, so it is difficult to meet the training standards. Therefore, based on TPACK theory, this paper analyzes the problems in complex skills learning, studies the system elements of 4C/ID model, and puts forward a complex skill learning design framework that combines TPACK theory and 4C/ID model. Then explores supporting information, real-time information and project practice training, in order to improve students' comprehensive application ability of complex skills.

articleTitle: ATC: An Automatic Text Comparison Tool Based on Diff Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Text comparison is to look up the differences and commonness between texts, so it is widely used in editing, duplicate checking, keywords extraction and so on. To improve the efficiency of batch text comparison, we have designed an automatic text comparison tool (ATC) based on Diff algorithm. According to the pipeline design mode, ATC combines multiple processes such as multiple data sources access, file filtering, de-duplication, extraction, comparison, and display, while using multithreading technology to accelerate the text comparison process. The experimental results show that ATC can be applied to multilingual text comparison, and the introduction of multithreading technology has also greatly improved the comparison efficiency.

articleTitle: Research On Apple Classification System Based On Hybrid Kernel Function And Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traditional apple classification has been done by measuring the size and shape features level of apple, but this exists the problem of inaccurate; In order to solve this problem, Yantai Red Fuji Apple was taken as the research object, and then the Canny edge algorithm was used to extract the outer contour of the apple, and then the size features were extracted by calculating the distance from each point on the outer contour to the geometric center. The ratio of the transverse diameters is proposed to extract the fruit-shaped features by the circle-like method, which overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional classification method.

articleTitle: The Strategy of Beating the Intermediate Basis Attack in Quantum Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Quantum communication network is a new type of secure communication technique and has drawn a lot of attentions in recent years, it has absolute safety in theory. However, quantum communication networks can still be attacked in different ways, among which the intermediate basis attack based on intercept-resend is a typical eavesdropping strategy. With this method, The probability of the eavesdropper correctly guessing the sender's code value can reach up to 0.854, resulting in the quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 0.25. To improve the security performance of quantum communication networks, we propose a strategy based on attack basis detection for beating the intermediate basis attack named “WN19”. In WN19, we can reduce QBER and the probability of the eavesdropper obtaining information correctly by adjusting the initial state of the quantum state of the sender according to the result of attack basis detection. The simulation results show that if the polarization angle $\theta$ of the attack basis is $\pi/8$, the QBER reduces from 0.25 to 0.1367 and the probability of eavesdropper correctly obtaining information decreases from 0.854 to 0.5811. It effectively improves the security of quantum cryptography under intermediate basis attack and provides a theoretical basis for the healthy development of quantum communication system.

articleTitle: Research On Mine Data Sharing Scheme Based On Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Combined with the actual analysis of the current mining data sharing protocols inconsistencies, ineffective data fusion, poor security and serious centralization, this paper proposes a mining data sharing scheme based on Blockhain. First, through analysis of national standards and policies, it is determined that the ultimate goal of the mine is to achieve “smart mines”, and the data sharing technology of the Blockchain is proposed; second, by analyzing the existing data sharing schemes, the problems existing in the schemes are raised; again Based on the existing sharing model, a mine data sharing scheme supported by Blockchain technology was proposed. Finally, the advantages of the sharing scheme proposed in this paper are explained. Through comparative analysis, it is found that the data sharing scheme proposed in this paper has advantages such as more transparent data, more secure data, and more efficient sharing compared to the national scheme under construction. The development of mine monitoring system provides a direction.

articleTitle: Optical Footprint Image Recognition Algorithm Based on Metric Learning and SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Footprint recognition plays an important role in criminal investigation, security protection and other fields. In terms of the key problems of feature extraction and classification, a footprint recognition algorithm is proposed based on optical footprint images. The algorithm first transforms the footprint image into the complex frequency domain through the dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT), then extracts the histogram of oriented gradient (HOG) features of the footprint image in the complex frequency domain. Finally, a symmetric projection matrix is obtained through metric learning. The symmetric projection matrix is used to project the original features to a new feature space. And then the SVM is used to identify the optical footprint in the new feature space. The experimental results show that on the optical footprint images of 134 people, the recognition accuracy of the algorithm in this paper is improved, which is valid to help the application and research of footprints.

articleTitle: Deterministic Schemes of Copyset Replication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In distributed systems, the stored data are replicated in multiple nodes to prevent data loss. Copyset replication (CR) is a replication placement strategy providing a trade-0ff between the scatter width and the probability of data loss. However, CR is not deterministic. Therefore, it is difficult to predict the time required and end condition. In this paper, we present two deterministic schemes to find out the placement strategy in linear time, when the parameters are within the given range. In particular, the second scheme can generate the optimal placement strategy that cannot be generated by CR. Further, the optimality of the second scheme is also proved. In general, this paper has improved CR and proposed a better scheme.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of the Technology of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence to Audit
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has great advantages in improving the audit efficiency, reducing the audit risk and changing the work mode, which can help find value and create value for audit, and greatly improve the quality of audit. But it will also bring some new technical and systemic risks, which have profound influence on the subject and object. The theory and practice of audit must be carefully analyzed, in particular, by using data mining to make audit judgments, using association statistics to detect trails, using cluster analysis to determine the focus of audit content, using intelligent visualization to speed up the progress of audit, using distributed processing system to improve the effectiveness of audit.

articleTitle: Research On Persistent Management Model of Component State
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This article researches Vue component development ideas, analyzes Vue technical characteristics and component state management tools, and draws the problem that it is difficult to manage and control the component state in front-end component development. Based on the actual application scenario and development process, a component state persistence management model was proposed. At the same time, this model was integrated with the Vue component development model, and a clear and transparent component working mechanism was obtained. At the actual application level, the data flow direction of the component is clarified, and the ability to persistently control the component state during the front-end component development process is enhanced. The component state persistence management model described in this article extends the application scenario of Vue application project state management and improves the efficiency of component state management.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Toolbox Based on Component Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the country's implementation of smart mines, Internet technology has been well integrated into the mine disaster prevention system. In order to improve the accuracy and timeliness of mine monitoring data, each mine has established a mine data monitoring system suitable for its situation. As the most important part of the monitoring software, the data monitoring module needs to be able to dynamically meet the various needs of users. This article mainly introduces the tools that use the component technology to package the data monitoring module into a toolbox. The user calls the dynamic link library through reflection technology to implement various functions in the toolbox, and implements the toolbox controls and data monitoring software developed by third-party platforms Organic combination. Solved the poor scalability of monitoring software, Problems requiring frequent software replacement for customers after system update. This method has proved its good flexibility and timeliness in a hydrological monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Copyright Infringement Based on Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Since the popularity of the Internet, more and more people have chosen to look for the information and resources they need on the Internet. People's lives have gradually been changed by the Internet. Cloud storage brings new development opportunities, and the copyright protection issues involved in cloud storage are gradually emerging. Cloud storage has changed the original pattern among traditional information owners, disseminators and users, causing conflicts among copyright owners, cloud storage servers and information acquirers, and the problem of copyright protection has become increasingly prominent. The rapid development of network file sharing platforms such as cloud storage brings unprecedented challenges to copyright protection. The application and development of cloud storage also challenges the recognition of traditional copyright system, object and content, so we must balance the contribution of cloud storage to the exchange of information resources and protect the legitimate rights and interests of copyright holders.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of the system for the identification, supervision and privacy protection of targeted poverty alleviation for poverty-stricken college students based on big data technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Under the guidance of “ensuring that children do not drop out of school due to poverty China has established a broad and universal subsidy system for poverty-stricken students in colleges and universities, which has achieved phased results. However, during the implementation, there are still some bad phenomena such as “fake poverty-stricken students This paper will focus on the application of big data technology to solve the above problems through technical means. It also studies the optimization of the system from three aspects: logical structure design, physical structure design and flow chart design of the big data service platform for poverty-stricken college students.

articleTitle: Role-classification-based Access Control Mechanism for Energy Internet of Things Data Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of Internet of things technology, the energy industry is gradually entering the era of "wisdom". The data service platform provides valuable information services to the ISV in the form of the API through collection, cleaning, transmission, storage, and mining. The API access control is one of the most important parts of the data service platform, unreasonable access control will lead to data chaos between applications, resource leakage and other problems. The application of traditional access control technology to the energy Internet of things data service platform with huge data resources will increase the complexity of the platform and the possibility of unauthorized attacks. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes the concept of role classification based on the role-based access control mechanism (RBAC) [1], assigning roles and grades to API and third-party applications respectively, and implementing permission control through the double check of roles and grades. The analysis and evaluation of the proposed role-classification-based access control mechanism through using case evaluation showing that this mechanism can effectively control the API, the security of the platform is greatly improved, and the platform data resources can be reasonably invoked between applications.

articleTitle: Application of Two-dimensional Code Technology in Prefabricated Beam Factory Production Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of quality control and traceability of prefabricated beams, the two-dimensional code technology is applied to the production process management of prefabricated beams. The system makes full use of the convenient advantages of mobile Internet and uses mobile app to scan QR code to input the information of precast beam production, quality inspection and production information query. With the help of Baidu map API, the system realizes the positioning management of precast beam construction. The system provides customized query report based on data mining technology for the data generated in the production process. Through the development of the precast beam production management system with twodimensional code as the medium, it can monitor the whole process of production management, ensure the orderly construction, optimize the management process, and achieve the quality monitoring and quality traceability of precast beam production.

articleTitle: QKD Protocol To Enhance The Southbound Security Of Software Defined Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The combination of quantum encryption and internet technology has become an inevitable development trend. To improve the security performance of communication between control layer and forwarding layer in the software defined network (SDN), we propose a security scheme based on quantum encryption technology. The proposed scheme can realize two-way authentication and quantum key distribution between the controller and the switch. The security performance analysis shows that this scheme can effectively prevent eavesdropping attacks, man-in-the-middle attacks and replay attacks. It effectively improves the southbound security of SDN and provides a theoretical basis for the healthy development of SDN.

articleTitle: Object Intelligent Detection and Implementation Based on Neural Network and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantage of high false detection rate in target classification detection using existing feature training classifiers, this paper proposes a moving target detection algorithm based on convolutional neural network on the basis of deep learning. On the image to be checked, sliding windows of different scales are used to determine whether there is a object window. In object detection, a convolutional neural network is trained with a large number of positive and negative samples. In order to better adapt to object detection, the topology of the convolutional neural network is improved. The window of suspected object is input into the improved convolutional neural network for object detection, and the false detection rate is reduced on the basis of maintaining the original detection rate.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Marketing in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper starts with the analysis of the role of computer network in e-commerce, and then analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of computer network marketing in e-commerce, including the advantages of computer network marketing such as fast speed, wide scope of authority, small investment, and the few customers that e-commerce faces at present. Thirdly, it elaborates the strategy of computer network marketing in e-commerce in the era of rapid development of science and technology. Starting from the needs of the times, while the rapid development of computer network, the computer network marketing strategy in e-commerce has been improved.

articleTitle: A Selection Method of Path for Concurrent Multipath Transfer Based on Network Layer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Concurrent multipath transmission(CMT) can be used to increase the network resource utilization ratio and the network reliability, compared with the single path transmission as used in ordinary networks. In this paper, we propose a dynamic selection method of path for CMT, which is dedicated to solving the problem of network transmission performance degradation caused by the quality difference in transmission paths. This method implements CMT at the network layer based on Vector Network(VN) which is a new type of connection-oriented network. The combination of path bandwidth utilization and average queue length is used to measure path transmission quality. And a concept of memory factor is proposed to measure the load level of the path from the perspective of load balancing. Then the combination of these two indicators is used as the weight of the path to select the path. We have carried out simulation experiments and obtained results using OMNET simulator. Experimental results show that this method can significantly improve network throughput by 12.16% com-pared with other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Access Mechanism of Massive Machine Type Communications in Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: When facing the application of industrial Internet of things, the main problem of massive Machine Type Communications (MTC) is that when massive MTC devices directly access the cellular network, it will cause congestion, which will cause some MTC devices and cellular user devices unable to access the network normally, and at the same time, it will cause huge signaling overhead in the cellular network. In order to solve these problems, this paper first analyzes the principle of massive MTC related access mechanism, proposes a massive MTC device resource management mode based on cluster mode, and gives the static and dynamic management mechanism of cluster. This mechanism takes the optimal cluster size and the fairness principle of cluster members into account. In the case of limited cellular resources, it can achieve reliable access to massive MTC.

articleTitle: Identity-based Format Preserving Encryption of Data Desensitization Program
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Data masking is the core technology to eliminate privacy sensitive information in finance, power and other industries. FPE (Format Preserving Encryption) is used for data desensitization due to the reason that its ciphertext and plaintext are in the same message space. Both the ciphertext and plaintext have the same format characteristics. Based on the traditional format-preserving encryption desensitization scheme, this paper proposes a general model for the application of identity-based format pre-encryption (IB-FPE) in data desensitization technology. Firstly, the solution preserves the traditional format retention encryption scheme and maintains data integrity efficiently. Secondly, by improving the key generation function, the identity information is associated with the master key, thereby locating and limiting the damage caused by the key exposure to the format retention encryption. Finally, by increasing the processing opinion of segmented data, the efficiency of the format-preserving encryption desensitization scheme is improved and the data desensitization process of the specific example is analyzed, and the security and efficiency of the scheme are analyzed.

articleTitle: The Research and Practice of a General Data Management Tool on Multivariate Marine Geology Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper a general data management tool based on Oracle database and Spring MVC framework is designed and developed, which takes advantage of oracle's high-performance nested query and combines the recursive data of relational database with the front-end tree structure. The general data management tool allows customizing data directories and data structures as needed, thus the storage and query of multivariate data can be realized. We have accumulated a large amount of various data in the field of marine geology and the data management tool has been applied in the platform of marine geological information management.

articleTitle: Distributed Fusion State Estimation Based on Coded Measurements
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The problem of distributed fusion state estimation for a spatially array of sensors in Network Control System (NCS) is studied. The measurement of each sensor is transmitted through a lossy chain, and the dropped packet model of each chain is independent and identically distributed. To reduce the requirement of communication bandwidth and the impact of packet loss, a compressed coding scheme is proposed, which combines the measurement of each sensor to make the transmitted information a scalar. Then, the local estimation and the local estimation error covariance in the case of packet loss are obtained. Then, the linear unbiased estimation method is used for distributed fusion state estimation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is confirmed by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Key Technologies of Public Security Virtual Reality Based on Panoramic Video
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This project combines panoramic video technology with VR virtual reality technology, setting up virtual scenes, and applies it to emergency escape prevention drill. This study developed the emergency drill system based on Unity3D platform, imported live video, combined with virtual reality effects for rendering, built escape environment scenes with a high sense of immersion, and conducted hot spot query and interaction in VR scenes. With the hotspot interactive technology of panoramic video, the application scope of panoramic video expands and the video content are more finely refined.

articleTitle: Research on Video Recommendation Algorithm Based on Bullet Screen
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet industry in the era of Web 2.0, the creation and sharing of content becomes more and more easy, and people's access to information changes accordingly. For information consumers, the exponential growth of information reduces the efficiency of information utilization, and users are eager to obtain more valuable information; for information producers, it is also hoped that there is a way to make information be more concerned by potential users. In order to solve this problem, personalized recommendation system is widely used in all aspects. The emergence of video recommendation system enables users to upgrade from active search to automatic recommendation in the way of obtaining videos, which reduces the time for users to find interested videos, makes video browsing more efficient, and greatly improves the user experience of video websites. In this paper, a video recommendation algorithm based on bullet curtain is proposed to improve the existing recommendation algorithm, and improve the relevance of recommendation results with video and users.

articleTitle: A hybrid prediction of wind speed based on variational mode decomposition method and long short-term memory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: As wind speed directly influences wind energy generation, the improvement of the accuracy of wind speed forecasting algorithms has significant technological and economic impacts on wind energy generation. In this paper, a hybrid prediction model of wind speed based on variational mode decomposition (VMD), Nash-Sutcliffe coefficient of efficiency (NSCE) and long short-term memory (LSTM), referred to as VMD-NSCE-LSTM, is proposed to predict the wind speed. Firstly, the VMD is used to decomposes the wind speed time series into amplitude modulation and frequency modulation. Secondly, the long short-term memory (LSTM) is used to forecast each intrinsic mode function (IMF) of the VMD. Finally, the forecasting results of IMF are combined according to the evaluation criteria of the Nash-Sutcliffe coefficient of efficiency (NSCE). The simulation results show that the hybrid VMDNSCE-LSTM models can significantly improve the accuracy of wind speed prediction.

articleTitle: Study on Chinese Text Clustering Algorithm Based on K-mean and Evaluation Method on Effect of Clustering for Software-intensive System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Software fault continues growing in importance to the factors of equipment failure. Analysis and utilization in amount of text data is important content for research of software failure and reliability of software-intensive system. Algorithm based on k-mean is proposed, in which the calculated cluster-head (CH) out of real text node sample set was replaced with one text node nearest to it in the real text set. Distance between two text nodes is computed by Euclidean distance. Then evaluation method of clustering effect based on Entropy is presented for text clustering algorithm. At last, experiments show that the improved algorithm can solve the problem of empty cluster. Empty cluster means that the calculated CH may be visual text node out of real text node sample set in the progress of k-mean algorithm. Furthermore, the evaluation method can obtain the best clustering result and optimal number of cluster-heads (CHs).

Author Keywords: Node out of text sample set

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Computer Intelligent Proofreading System Based on the Perspective of English Translation Application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to factors such as algorithm and matching degree, English machine translation still has bottlenecks. Therefore, this paper proposes a computer intelligent proofing model based on the perspective of English translation application and conducts research and development. Experiments based on this model show that the computer intelligent proofing model based on the perspective of English translation application can bring better translation performance in terms of automatics score and more grammatical coherence. Finally, the development of computer intelligent proof reading system is discussed from both hardware and software aspects.

articleTitle: Research On Real Time Tracking and Positioning System of Products of Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Industry 4.0 has a key technology point, that is, intelligent factories use “raw materials” with information to complete production tracking. High performance real-time positioning system is an important part of realizing real-time tracking and positioning of materials in the industrial Internet of things. Passive UHF RFID technology has become the first choice of industry 4.0 material real-time positioning system. This paper analyzes RFID positioning technology, then gives the real-time RFID information driven production line process architecture of workshop manufacturing resources and the classification and management scheme of multi-source real-time manufacturing information. And this paper realizes the RFID tracking and positioning of workshop manufacturing resources.

articleTitle: A Flame Detection Algorithm Based on Bag of Words for Power Safety
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Flame detection algorithm is one of the key technologies for power safety early warning. In order to improve the accuracy of flame detection, this paper proposes an algorithm based on word bag model. Firstly, the shape feature of flame is extracted according to the growth of flame area between consecutive frames. Then, the flicker frequency of flame is analyzed by the number of brightness jump of flame pixels in a period of time. At the same time, a new word bag model is proposed to describe the flame motion characteristics. Finally, the validity of these features as the criteria of flame recognition is demonstrated by experiments. The simulation results show that the flame recognition algorithm proposed in this paper can recognize the flame effectively.

articleTitle: The Typed Path of Mobile Audio Platform Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the emergence of network information technology and various new multimedia mobile access technologies, mobile audio applications usher in vast space and new opportunities. Mobile audio transmission follows the development law of sound media, and explores the typification path in the integration of new media. This paper analyzes several typification modes of mobile audio platform under the background of information technology and discusses the typification competition strategies of mobile audio APP.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Control Mode of Urban Rail Transit Based on Intelligent Transportation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Regional coordinated development of rail transit stations is an important strategy and trend for the sustainable development of cities. It can promote the efficient operation of regional functions, realize regional catalysis and promote the compact development mode of public transportation priority. Inter-city rail transit has become a link between large cities and small and medium-sized cities in the region with the advantages of punctuality, speed and large capacity. Regional economic integration is one of the important features of the world economic development today, which coincides with the concept of regional coordinated development. The construction of intercity rail transit integrates the regional spatial structure, drives the development of regional economy along the line, and creates necessary conditions for the formation of metropolitan economic belt in developed areas. With the development of science and technology and urbanization, rail transit with large volume plays an increasingly important role in modern cities. In urban rail transit system, the control of signal system is an important part to ensure the safety of rail transit. This paper analyzes the historical experience of intelligent transportation, and studies the signal control method of urban rail transit.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Method of Interaction Between Environment and Equipment Maneuverability
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduces a simulation method of the interaction between environment and equipment maneuverability. The simulation software of the interaction between environment and equipment maneuverability includes the simulation model of the interaction between environment and equipment maneuverability and the simulation model of collision detection. It mainly simulates the influence of terrain elements on equipment maneuvering and the collision between equipment, personnel and environmental entities. It not only considers the related elements of interaction, but also facilitates the software implementation. This method satisfies the application of practical projects.

articleTitle: Application of Variable Frequency Drive in Lifting System of Ropeway
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of variable frequency speed regulation technology, variable frequency drive have been widely used in ropeway lifting systems. According to the working characteristics of the funicular, this paper introduces the composition of the cableway hoisting system, the principle and implementation of the variable frequency speed regulating system. In the paper the control method of frequency converter ac speed regulation is put forward and the key technical issues of speed regulation control are analyzed. Because of application of frequency converter, the control line of the ropeway is simplified, the system operation fault is reduced, the system maintenance task is lightened, the impact on the power grid is avoided, and the safe and stable operation of the ropeway system is better realized.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation of Rural Financial Risk Early Warning Model Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Compared with the traditional finance, the risk problem of rural finance is more complex, and some technical problems of risk prevention need to be solved. How to identify and predict the risks in rural finance and manage them effectively is the key issue to ensure the steady development of the whole rural industry. Therefore, this paper makes a comprehensive analysis of the risk factors in rural finance, and then use data mining method to establish the rural financial risk early warning neural network model, and clarify its input node, hidden layer node and output node. By MATLAB programming tool, to standardize and normalize the actual data, and train the theoretical model through numerical calculation, to obtain the actual output and expected output value. It proves that using BP neural network algorithm to build rural financial risk early warning model and conduct arithmetic operation with MATLAB is technically feasible.

articleTitle: Design of Slope Displacement Monitoring and Early Warning System Based on Beidou
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, reports of geological hazards such as landslides, mudslides, ground subsidence, and ground fissures caused by various reasons have frequently appeared, causing great personal and economic losses. These geological disasters have a common feature. The occurrence of disasters is accompanied by the movement of locations, which is sudden and strong, and instantly destroys roads, bridges and other transportation facilities. Therefore, the Beidou-based slope displacement monitoring and early warning system was designed and developed, which integrates Beidou positioning technology, communication technology, sensor technology and other modern technologies. The Beidou-based slope displacement monitoring and early warning system can collect horizontal and vertical displacement data, rainfall data, and ground stress data. Through the analysis and processing of these collected large amounts of data, a set of earlywarning values has been established to realize the delineation of the early-warning red line, and the early-warning system that presents monitoring data and broadcasts early-warning information. The engineering test shows that the system has the feasibility of project promotion and demonstration application.

articleTitle: Study on Feeder Protection Method of Metro Traction Electric Network Considering Oscillation Blocking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The electric energy required by the subway is directly taken from the dc traction network, but the oscillating current in the traction network system frequently causes the mis operation of the feeder protection of the traction network. By studying the difference of oscillation current and short-circuit current waveform characteristics in the system, a new protection algorithm is proposed, and LabVIEW is used as a tool to program software package. By comparing the new algorithm with the existing wavelet packet energy spectrum diagnosis algorithm, the advantages of the new algorithm are shown.

articleTitle: Research on Situation Awareness of Universities’ Network Information Security in the Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Recently network threats faced by universities are constantly escalating, and the traditional means of protection have been unable to meet the current network information security situation. Big data technology can integrate massive logs data and analyze network security risks in real time, so as to implement functions such as network assets management, massive logs management, security events analysis, attack events tracing, dangerous events warning, and security situation awareness, and consequently building up a comprehensive network information security system to provide decision support for network information security in universities.

articleTitle: Fragmentation and Reconstruction of China's Fiscal Budget Expenditure Performance from the Perspective of Big Data Take the administrative budget of Wuhan municipal government as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This article collects and analyzes the budget of Wuhan municipal government for 2009-2017, and builds a linear regression model with Eviews analysis of covariance. Through this model, the empirical research on the performance of Wuhan's administrative budget expenditure is carried out from such factors as the "three public funds" budget, the budget of the government fiscal revenue and expenditure, the level of national economic development, the number of population, and the registered urban unemployment rate. Research shows that the low overall budget performance of Wuhan is caused by a variety of factors, and its administrative budget cost has a significant positive correlation with the level of regional economic development. Finally, this article proposes an optimization plan from the perspective of budget management.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Visual guide in the Dining Space Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the environment of the dining space and enhance the competitiveness of the catering brand to adapt to the international trend in the catering service industry, this paper studies and discusses the design and application from two aspects including catering environment space and Visual guide. It is demonstrated that Visual guide plays a coordinating role in guiding the visual effect and obeying the overall environmental effect in the catering environment, and it has unique insights in case application research.

articleTitle: A Universal Automated Test Solution for Trunking Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the portability of the automated test of the trunking communication system, this paper proposed a universal automated test solution for the trunking communication system. It's based on the general architecture design of the trunking communication system, providing a replaceable communication protocol codec module. With the DSL-defined test script language describing the test cases, and efficient scheduling schemes for the test task, the automated functional test and performance test of the trunking communication system are realized. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the minimum load test task scheduling scheme based on user operation load prediction has lower response time and lower load balancing effect compared with the traditional static task scheduling scheme.

articleTitle: The Sources of Salinity Changes in Jiaozhou Bay
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the investigation data of Jiaozhou Bay in May and October 1979, the salinity and the distribution of salinity in surface in Jiaozhou Bay were studied. articleTitle: Phased Array of Data Transmission System for Earth Observing Satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Phased array is a new type of data transmission antenna for remote sensing satellite. The antenna scans its beam to keep the advantage of wide area coverage and high gain to get large EIRP. According to the general requirements of data transmission subsystem employed for earth observing satellite, the relationship of the parameters subject to the phased array data transmission is analyzed. A design of data transmission system suitable for engineering application and a demonstration antenna array is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Commonality Evaluation Method of Civil Aircraft Maintenance Technical Publications Based on Improved Design Structure Matrix
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The commonality evaluation of civil aircraft operation support products has become increasingly important in the overall design and operation support phase of modern civil aircraft products. The commonality evaluation of technical publications is an important part of that, but the evaluation methods suitable for it are still lacking. Therefore, by taking maintenance technical publications as the research object, a commonality evaluation method based on the improved design structure matrix is proposed in this paper. By extracting key indexes, the commonality evaluation index system of civil aircraft maintenance technical publications is established. The traditional design structure matrix is improved, and the structural index is quantified based on the improved design structure matrix. Finally, the commonality of technical publications is characterized by the calculated modified Hamming distance between the improved design structure matrices of manuals, and an example is given to verify it.

articleTitle: Overview of Space Plug-and-Play Avionics Interface Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The space plug-and-play avionics (SPA) technology can meet the requirements of rapid development of micro satellites, and has become a hot research topic in space technology at present. The SPA system as a whole is a set of interface-driven standards, and the interface standards play a key role in the SPA architecture. This article comprehensively sorts out SPA interface standards. Firstly, the development status of SPA technology is introduced; secondly, the SPA interface model adapted to different device types is analyzed, and the functions of the main interface standards are introduced in detail, such as I2C-based SPA-1, USB-based SPA-U, SpaceWire-based SPA-S, and SPA-O based on optical network; finally, the typical applications of the SPA interface standards are analyzed.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Plasma Spraying Velocity Control System for Conical Screw Thread of Injection Molding Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The plasma spraying speed control system for the conical screw thread of injection molding machine was designed and simulated in order to improve the movement precision of the welding torch. According to the regularity of thread formation, the master-slave synchronous control system of double motor speed was designed, which completed the accurate movement of welding torch. The combination of Smith predictive compensation and single neuron PID control was adopted in the paper because of the relatively large hysteresis of master-slave synchronous control of dual motor speed. The algorithm used to adjust the parameters of the control system. The simulation has been carried out by the computer, and the result shows that it has better control effect.

articleTitle: Compare the security of biometrics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Safety is human instinct desire. Biometric technology is a mechanism for reasonably controlling desire to verify and provide secure access to facilities or systems based on the automatic and immediate verification of an individual's physical characteristics. This paper will discuss the iris recognition technology and vein recognition system with high security. In addition, other forms of biometrics will be mentioned and the security of each biometrics will be compared.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a DC Power Conversion Control System for Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: We produced a DC power conversion control system for photovoltaic power generation. The system uses the STM32 microcomputer as the control core and consists of the battery pack, INA282 voltage and current detection module, auxiliary power module, drive module, etc. The DC-DC converter 1 based on the buck chopper is used as MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) solar controller to control the photovoltaic panel to work at the maximum power point. The DC-DC converter 2 composed of synchronous Boost-Buck circuit charges and discharges the battery to stabilize the output voltage. The efficiency of the total system reaches 96.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Meteorological Early Warning Technology of Helicopter Patrol in High Altitude Area
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The terrain along the high altitude transmission line is complex, and the weather is changeable and the turbulence is obvious, which limits and challenges the safety of helicopter power grid patrol work, and there is no public network mobile communication signal along a large number of line sections. Therefore, the traditional on-line monitoring of transmission lines is difficult to provide effective support for the weather early warning during helicopter inspection. Through the design of software deployment, hardware deployment, communication networking and data transmission of real-time communication, this paper discusses a communication scheme of helicopter cruise weather early warning suitable for high-altitude areas, which provides an important reference for the work of helicopter cruise weather early warning and line operation and maintenance in high-altitude areas.

articleTitle: Research on Extraction of Mathematical Morphology Based on Improved PPI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Most of existing end-element extraction algorithms only use spectral information of image and treat data as spatially disordered spectral vectors, which make insufficient usage of spatial information of image. Therefore, PPI-AMEE algorithm proposed in this article combines design ideas of AMEE algorithm and PPI algorithm that is used to define expansion and corrosion operations in mathematical morphology. Moreover, purest pixel is found by accumulating PPI index of each pixel within structural element. Experimental results show that end element extraction accuracy of PPI-AMEE algorithm proposed in this paper is better than that of AMEE algorithm and PPI algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Citizen’s Personal Information Protection and Unified Certification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Network, information technology and smartphones are rapid development in recent years, and various computer network application service software and mobile APPs are wide application in people's daily life at the same time, so the protection and security of personal information problem has become the focus of the whole society. On the base of personal information certification and collection, this paper will discuss the personal information protection problem, put forward the suggestions and establish the citizen's personal information certification center.

Author Keywords: unified certification of network application services

articleTitle: Investigation of College Students’ Cognition of Live-streaming Platforms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, a variety of live platforms appear on the network. The live broadcast platform attracts a large number of College Students' attention. This study analyzes the college students' cognition of live-streaming platforms and explores how to guide the college students towards a rational understanding of these platforms.

articleTitle: Network Resources and the Construction of College Students’ Knowledge System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This article discusses the influence of network resource use on knowledge system construction. The paper analyzes the characteristics of network resources and its application, then it analyzes the impact of the use of network resources on the process of constructing a knowledge system in view of the knowledge system structure. Finally, it discusses how to make better use of network resources, expand the advantages of network resources, and avoid the problems of network resources from the perspective of the government, school, and individual.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Virtual Prototype Technology in Simulation Design of Paper Delivery Mechanism of Printing Press
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Research objectives: The application of digital virtual prototype technology in the simulation design of printing machine delivery mechanism is studied. Research methods: Through the modeling of three-dimensional entities, the assembly of models and the testing of equipment, the structural characteristics of parts are described by using geometric shapes. The relationship between assemblies is related and defined, and the application of digital virtual prototyping technology is analyzed by combining with the test results. Research conclusions: Digital virtual prototype technology has an important role in promoting many industries in China and the printing industry. The use of it not only meets the actual needs of the industry, but also effectively promotes the optimization of resources. Allocation is of great help to realize the sustainable development of China's economy and society. In view of the actual situation of the printing industry in China, the working mode of traditional printing press is relatively single. It is difficult to achieve effective guarantee of work efficiency, and at the same time it is impossible to guarantee the accuracy of the final data and unexpected effect.

articleTitle: Research on Evolutionary Game of Information Transfer Based on Supply-Hub in Supply Chain. Part I: Manufacturer and Supplier Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The introduction of the Supply-Hub supply chain operation model has greatly eased the "bull-whip effect" in the supply chain. However, due to the weak willingness of Supply-Hub supply chain enterprises to share information, " free-riding " and "self-interest", as well as information asymmetry, information sharing still has great problems. Based on the Supply-Hub operation mechanism, this work first establishes a game model for information transfer and evolution between manufacturers and suppliers in the supply chain, and analyzes the impact of parameter changes in the model on the choice of manufacturers and suppliers. Then use MATLAB software to analyze the strategy selection scheme and evolution trend of the manufacturer-supplier information transfer in the Supply-Hub supply chain under different revenue environments. The results show that the supply chain system is evolutionarily stable when manufacturers and suppliers adopt the same information strategies, and according to the influence of each parameter on the evolution results, a series of adjustment strategies are proposed.

articleTitle: Exploring how to develop innovation and entrepreneurship syllabuses in universities in Guangdong in the age of “Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the age of “Internet+”, the innovation and entrepreneurship syllabus provides a vital framework for innovation and entrepreneurship training at universities. To integrate course resources, optimize the innovation and entrepreneurship syllabuses and create an informatized training platform are the major directions for reforms of innovation and entrepreneurship education in universities. This paper concludes the experience of American universities in developing innovation and entrepreneurship syllabuses, analyzed the problems that universities in Guangdong have met in developing these syllabuses, such as absence of an overall plan, detachment between innovation and entrepreneurship education and specialty training, lack of experience among the teachers, to name a few. To develop innovation and entrepreneurship syllabuses, universities in Guangdong can make efforts in the following aspects: to conduct overall planning in a top-down manner and provide favorable policies; to develop online course platforms to improve the quality of informatized education; to develop a layered and comprehensive syllabus for innovation and entrepreneurship education; to develop a faculty of “triple-competent teachers” to improve the quality of teaching; to connect to major national development strategies, integrate resources in and out of the universities and improve the quality of courses. Establishing innovation and entrepreneurship syllabuses in universities in Guangdong will provide talents needed to boost the advancement of the Guangdong- Hong Kong- Macau Greater Bay Area and the Belt and Road Initiative.

articleTitle: Impact of Big Data Technology on Policy Formulation in Public Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Essentially, public policy as a distribution of social benefits will be legal that it must be the consent of most people. Therefore, it is particularly important whether public policies can be recognized and satisfied by most people. Especially in public emergencies, the big data analysis can accurately and quickly reflect the demands of the group, which helps to improve the rationality and pertinence of public policy formulation. This article believes that governments at all levels can grasp the demands of the masses and formulate targeted and satisfactory public policies with high public satisfaction by big data analysis.

articleTitle: An Attack Simulation Method for Power Industry Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the attack simulation technology, testers simulate hackers to attack the industrial control system, and judge whether the system contains specific security vulnerabilities according to the returned results. This technology has become an important security test method. Firstly, based on the vulnerability mechanism of electric power industry control protocol, this paper puts forward the model of attack data package assembly, confusion and encapsulation. By using multiple types of attack modules to achieve attack data package assembly, mutation and confusion, to ensure that attack data package can bypass the system protection mechanism and have the ability to avoid checking and killing, and then realize the protocol data package encapsulation according to the electric power industry control protocol specification. Secondly, this paper focuses on the test case that malicious message is expanded with the model of counter neural network to generate new effective attack data package, which effectively improves the vulnerability detection rate and reduces the security risk of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Folk Literature in the age of big data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: the materials and contents of folklore research are very rich, so for its academic research, the establishment of a large and comprehensive database is just the beginning of the work. The new changes brought by digitalization to humanities are far more than the convenience of data retrieval and processing. Especially in the big data environment, with the rapid development of computer and Internet technology, many scholars have reached a consensus on the research of Humanities and social sciences from many aspects and angles, which brings great theoretical and methodological significance, and the turning point is also effective. In view of this, this paper focuses on the application and development of digital means in the field of folklore research, as well as the achievements and existing problems. It is hoped that by displaying the current situation of the development of folk literature, further deepening the discussion and Thinking on the digital research of folk literature, and fully realizing the academic value and application value of folk literature research.

articleTitle: Research on Air Conditioning for New Energy Vehicle Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Conventional automobile air-conditioning intelligent control system is applied in new energy vehicles, which is affected by the structure of the vehicle and has low control accuracy. Based on the assembly structure design of automotive air conditioning, as well as the design of temperature signal acquisition circuit, man-machine interface design, to achieve the new energy automotive air conditioning intelligent control system hardware design; Based on the work mode design of the system software, the design of the main process module of the system, and the design of the button scanning processing subroutine module, the software design of the air conditioning temperature control system of new energy vehicles can be realized. Complete the research on the intelligent control system of new energy automobile air conditioning. Experimental data show that the proposed intelligent control system of air conditioning for new energy vehicles is 22.85% more accurate than conventional intelligent control system of air conditioning for new energy vehicles, which is suitable for intelligent control of air conditioning for new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Influencing Factors of College Students’ Online Dating
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to explore the influencing factors that cause college students ’online dating, based on the previous research results, we propose three aspects of influencing factors of college students’ online dating, such as personality, gender, and social impact research hypotheses, and then use questionnaires to verify the authenticity. Finally, we conclude that College students who are emotionally frustrated, more active in character and affected by peer online dating are more likely to have online dating, while male and female college students have no significant difference in the probability of online dating.

articleTitle: Discussion of Design and Application of Live Broadcasting System Based on 5G + VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduces comprehensively the design ideas and implementation of VR live production system based on 5G in detail. It also analyzes the reliability of 5G and VR technology fusion modes, and converts PGM signal devices to SDI. In the end, the SDI can be smoothly input into the CPE receiving device of the 5G, thereby ensuring that the perfect restoration between video and sound, video and picture. Sound can be achieved without taking up other public resources and make the entire live stream more reasonable. Through the specific application on the 70th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China (PRC), it was verified that the application of this live broadcast system had preliminary experimental results with effective overall system design scheme.

articleTitle: Working Principle Analysis and Fault Setting System Design of Car Lighting Circuit Based on Modularization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of automobile electronic technology, higher requirements are put forward for automobile service personnel. In order to improve the technical level of automobile maintenance personnel, a modularized automobile lighting circuit fault setting system is proposed. First of all, the circuits of the headlights, the rear fog lamp and the front fog lamps of FAW (First Automotive Works) Weizhi car are taking as examples, the selection of which is typical. Analysis of its working principle and failure phenomena that may lead to unlit lights, burnt bulbs, normally lit lights, dim lights and other failures shows that it may contain 59 fault points. Then, a modular design idea and control logic is proposed. Select the STC12C5A60S2 main control single-chip microcomputer, decoders, drivers, relays, the LCD liquid crystal display and other main devices, and design the connection relationship between the devices and necessary auxiliary circuits. The key module is used to select the corresponding fault and display it on the LCD screen. The single-chip controls decoders to output a low level, and then drivers control the operation of the corresponding relays to achieve the management of the fault lines, which helps to realize the setting of three typical fault causes such as open circuit, short circuit and poor contact.

articleTitle: Sentence Embedding Model Based on Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The method of calculating the word vector using the neural network method provides the motivation for generating the representation model of the sentence. For the smooth inverse frequency sentence vector model, only the word frequency information on the general data set is considered to calculate the word weight, but when it is specific to the task, the problem that the different words contribute differently to the task and its weight correction is not considered. According to the distribution of characteristic words in different categories in the dataset, the task contribution factor (TCF) is proposed by using the improved information gain feature selection method. Based on this factor, a sentence vector representation model (IIG-SIF) based on task contribution is proposed. By testing on the standard text classification dataset 20 Newsgroups and the text similarity calculation dataset SICK, the IIG-SIF model has a greater improvement in the two tasks of text categorization and Text similarity calculation than the original SIF model.

articleTitle: Research on Workshop Manufacturing Resource Scheduling Control Method Based on Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The industrial internet of things has become the main solution of the dynamic scheduling method used in the workshop scheduling mechanism. In this paper, based on the research of hierarchical production planning and scheduling control method in the industrial 4.0 production environment, a resource scheduling framework based on the information feedback of the industrial internet of things is proposed, and the industrial internet of things technology is used to fully obtain more fine-grained bottom operation execution process data. This paper proposes a scheduling method design based on the information feedback of the industrial internet of things. Through the feedback of the bottom real-time information, the production process scheduling and planning results are fed back layer by layer, so that the production process control can better meet the production index requirements of each stage.

articleTitle: Analysis and Study of Several Game Algorithms for Public Safety
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Security issues have always been the focus of attention in countries around the world. In the past few years, game theory has gradually formed some algorithms in the field of resource allocation and scheduling in the security field and has been successfully applied in related aspects. This paper elaborates the research status of resource allocation algorithm in security game model, then the algorithm and model are analyzed in detail. Finally, the problems and application value are evaluated objectively in order to provide reference for similar research. At present, ARMOR patrol scheduling system based on DOBSS algorithm has been successfully applied in this field. There is also an IRIS air police dispatch system based on ASPEN extended algorithm. And TRUST urban rail safety transportation system with compact representation of mixed strategies. Even HBGS algorithm can be closely combined with various related algorithms in the future.

articleTitle: Progress in the Construction of Marine Observation Data Sources on the Western Route of the Maritime Silk Road
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper describes the process to build marine observation data sources of the National Marine Environment Forecast Center of the Ministry of Natural Resources through various channels, which has been relying on China's national basic marine observation system since 2013 and taking the western route of the Maritime Silk Road as the target through a variety of diplomatic channels and international cooperation channels, as well as scientific and technological cooperation and information technology methods. The data sources on the western route of the Maritime Silk Road are in a chain structure, including South China Sea ocean observation system which is autonomous, perfect and efficient, North Indian Ocean observation network which is autonomous, international cooperated, sharing, exchange with other forms of integration and initial formation system; rapid developing Mediterranean ocean observation system and loose Atlantic Ocean observation framework. This vast ocean observation data source project has not only made an important contribution to the disaster prevention of the Maritime Silk Road, but also laid a solid data foundation for the development of China's global ocean forecasting technology. There is no end to the Maritime Silk Road, and the exploration of the ocean observation data sources for the Maritime Silk Road is endless.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Business Architecture Construction of Large Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the gradual deepening and expansion of the scale of enterprise information construction, it is increasingly required that the system can break business barriers and data barriers, so that it can realize a new software design idea of data sharing, technology sharing and collaboration. Based on the experience of large-scale integration projects, this paper first analyzes the maturity of enterprise business, discusses how to do a good planning and design in the conceptual stage of project start-up, and promotes the whole process management of the project. Next, it enables demanders and developers to communicate effectively under a unified business architecture, and with the help of big data technology, allows designers to sort out the focus of the public and ideal deliverables based on data analysis of various indicators accumulated by previous systems. Finally, the project team can achieve the output of deliverables quickly and accurately.
