This method has great development potential for software R & D, and it can be widely used in major enterprises. It also brings effective solutions for later enterprises in the face of complex integrated projects.

articleTitle: Automatic double region of interest selection for spotting micro-expression from long videos
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Micro expression is a short-lived expression made unconsciously when people try to hide emotion. The spotting of micro expression can help to reveal the real emotion. Micro expression has been used in national security, judicial system, medical and clinical fields, but it is very difficult to detect and recognize. This paper presents a method of automatic double region of interest selection to detect the time point of occurrence of micro expression. The method was tested on the CASME2, SMICE-HS, SMIC-E-NIR, and SMIC-E-VIS databases. LBP and MDMO are used as feature extractors to represent the texture and dynamic changes of each frame in the sequence. The experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the performance of spotting.

articleTitle: Research on International Relations in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the past few years, artificial intelligence has developed much faster than people expected. The scenes we have seen in film and television works such as “Terminator”, “The Matrix”, and “Blade Runner” seem to be increasingly likely to become reality in the future. Accordingly, the influence of artificial intelligence on world politics is increasing. Even some recent news broke that artificial intelligence had profoundly affected big-power politics before then. For example, Cambridege Analitic, which is believed to have an official background in Russia, was exposed to use artificial intelligence and big data analysis to affect the US election and Brexit. Situations like these show that artificial intelligence and big data analysis have already had a significant impact on the world's political landscape.

articleTitle: Application of cloud computing technology in metal exploration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of economy, the progress of China's industry is increasingly obvious, so the demand for metals is also increasing. However, most of the metal resources on the surface of the earth are very scarce at present. Therefore, in order to meet the demand of economic development, entrepreneurs began to find better ways to mine the deep metal resources on the earth's surface. Starting from metal exploration, this paper focuses on the application of cloud computing technology in metal exploration. First, this paper introduces two key technologies of cloud computing, namely MapReduce programming model and HBase non-relational database. MapReduce programming model can be applied to parallel computing of a large number of data sets and scheduling processing when multiple tasks are running together, HBase non-relational database B-database is a database that can store data by columns, and can handle more complex unstructured data. Secondly, the experiment in this paper is divided into two steps. The first step is to build the cloud platform, the second step is to input the database. For the construction of the cloud platform, this paper uses four CentOS system computers to build the operation environment of Hadoop + HBase fully distributed mode. The final research results can show that the efficiency of metal exploration in 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019 has increased by 3.4%,4.2%,5.1%,5.9%.

articleTitle: Simulation Strategy of Bidding Behavior for Electricity Retailers in Direct Transactions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the medium and long-term electricity direct transactions, electricity retailers account for most of the demand-side market. Study the bidding behavior of electricity retailers is of great significance for evaluation of market model and trading rules. The article analyzes the main factors that affect the bidding behavior of electricity sales companies from three aspects: the market environment, market rules, and the electricity supplier’s own factors. Based on this, comprehensive consideration of the asset background, operating objectives, retail contracts and other factors of the power retail company, an agency bidding model was established, which covering three types of typical power retail companies, including expansion, stability, conservativeness and price acceptance. And the RE-learning algorithm is used to optimize the bidding strategy. Finally, the bidding model is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Consensus of Multi-agent System Based on A Novel State Feedback Protocol
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: For the second-order multi-agent system with directed fixed topology, a novel control protocol based on the past state with state feedback and current state of the agent is proposed and the consensus of the system is studied in this paper. Based on the frequency domain analysis method and Nyquist criterion, the sufficient conditions for the system are analyzed. Moreover, the protocol can speed up the environment of MATLAB, we take the system composed of seven agents as an example for simulation, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed protocol.

articleTitle: Electronic Sensors for Monitoring Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, the development of China's power industry has been particularly fast, and people's requirements for the safety and reliability of the power industry have become higher and higher. Therefore, there are higher requirements for the quality of electrical equipment monitoring work. In the current monitoring process of electrical equipment, the role of electronic sensors is very important. Research and analysis of electronic sensors are discussed to discuss the application of electronic sensors in the monitoring process of electrical equipment. It is of great significance to promote the widespread application of electronic sensors in the construction of electrical equipment, and also has a positive effect on promoting the stable and safe development of the power industry.

articleTitle: Design of Microelectronic System Based on Front-end Readout Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the digital filtering technology of the frontend readout microelectronic system and its filter module, a frontend readout microcircuit system chip is designed to reduce the noise of the readout circuit, so as to improve the signal recognition efficiency of the detection system. Through to the front end to delve into detector system, based on the front end of the nuclear radiation detector and the front end of the readout circuit theory, this study adopts the Taiwan electrical and mechanical company TSMC 0.18 μm complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) process, designed a read analog frontend chip and testing its performance, including chip function and noise performance. The function test of the front-end circuit readout chip designed in this paper proves that the chip is qualified and its input range is 0.5~7fC and the noise equivalent charge is 109e+17.9e/pF. According to the conversion efficiency of the CdZnTe compound material detector, the detector can handle the equivalent energy within the range of 18~205keV. The linearity of SK filter decreases with the increase of signal, and the overall nonlinearity is less than 4%. Based on digital filter, the front-end readout circuit chip of radiation detection can meet the requirements of detection performance index, reduce the noise of the readout circuit, and improve the signal recognition efficiency of the detection system.

articleTitle: The Integrated Tourism English Teaching Mode of “Network Teaching Platform+Classroom”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous development of the Internet era, education reform has gradually begun to move closer to informatization, and English for Professional Purposes (ESP) has also begun to emerge a new model. This paper attempts to establish an integrated model of “network teaching platform classroom” to be applied in tourism-oriented English teaching. Based on the application category of tourism-oriented English, the paper designs a classroom plan under the integrated tourism-oriented English teaching model, and verifies the feasibility of the plan through the actual situation.

articleTitle: The Change Process of PHC Content from Sources in Water Bodies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the investigation data of Jiaozhou Bay in May, August and October, 1992, the variation of PHC content in the surface and bottom layers and the deposition process were studied. According to the definition and model of Content Change Angle of Dongfang Yang, the calculation results show that in the surface water, the Content Change Angle of Dongfang Yang is - 0.34° from May to August, and 0.28° from August to October. In the bottom water, from May to August, the Content Change Angle of Dongfang Yang is - 0.91°, and from August to October, the Content Change Angle of Dongfang Yang is 0.22°.According to the scale of time and space, in May, the oil spills transported PHC content to Jiaozhou Bay, but in August, there was no PHC content from any sources. From May to August, PHC content decreased slowly and to a relatively low level. In October, open seas currents transported PHC content to Jiaozhou Bay. From August to October, PHC content increased slowly and to a higher level. After PHC content passed through the water body, from May to August, the settling PHC content in bottom increased slowly and the increase was relatively small. From August to October, the settling PHC content in bottom increased a little slowly. Therefore, the author puts forward the change process of the material content transported from sources in water bodies: when materials are transported to a water body from sources, the material content in the surface of the water body will rise faster than that in the bottom, and the material content in both the surface and the bottom will start to rise slowly. When materials are not transported to a water body from sources, the material content in the bottom of the water body will decline faster than that in the surface of the water body, and the material content in both the surface water body and the bottom water body will begin to decline slowly.

Author Keywords: the Model of Content Change Angle

articleTitle: Interpretation of Big Data in Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: “Big data” has changed from a technical buzzword into a social wave, which has impacted the fields of information, politics, business, etc. As the producer and owner of data, the media industry is also affected by big data. The impact of big data on news communication is mainly reflected in the following aspects: enhance the communication effect, better meet the needs of the audience and predict the behavior of the audience; beneficial to the content innovation and strengthens the objectivity and profundity of news; enhance audience interaction and further enhance the value of audience feedback; promote the integration of media talents and put forward higher requirements for media literacy.

articleTitle: Breast Lesion Segmentation in Ultrasound Images by CDeep3M
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The proper segmentation of breast lesion based on mammography is crucial not only for traditional computer aided diagnosis but also for supervised learning by deep learning, which is significant for further quantitative analysis. To achieve a comprehensive diagnosis with versatile deep learning algorithms, a novel Docker based framework is proposed and designed by incorporating popular CNN based models CDeep3M. The validation is preceded under a unique amount of B-type ultrasound images. The results indicate that CDeep3M have a good capability for breast tumor prediction. Besides, the analysis shows that Docker framework is flexible and extensive for environmental construction for breast cancer real-time prediction, as well as other related applications.

articleTitle: Temporal Recursive Propagation Network for Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Efficient spatio-temporal information modeling is the key to action recognition. Present state-of-the-art suffers from the trade-off of spatiotemporal information modeling capability and model complexity. In this paper, we propose a novel temporal recursive propagation network (TRP) which can efficiently encode and fusion spatiotemporal information. TRP Module can be inserted in existing 2D CNN architectures such as ResNet and MobileNet. Abundant experiments show that TRP enjoys the performance over 3D CNN at lower computational cost than 2D CNN. We evaluate the proposed TRP on the large action recognition benchmark dataset UCF-101. TRP outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on UCF-101 from scratch.

articleTitle: An Efficient License Plate Location Algorithm Based on Deep Leaming
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness of the license plate location algorithm in complex environments and reduce the impact of complex background on the performance of the algorithm, a license plate location algorithm based on corner detection and deep learning is proposed. The algorithm first uses color segmentation to select the operating area, then uses the corner detection and morphological operations to segment out the area of interest, and finally uses a convolutional neural network to extract the deep features of the area of interest and get license plate area. The experiment compares the proposed algorithm with other algorithms by using the data set collected in a complex environment, and the results show that the algorithm is more robust in complex environments, and has a higher accuracy while ensuring the detection speed rate.

articleTitle: English Machine Translation Model Based on Modern Intelligent Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The statistical machine translation method based on the maximum entropy is adopted. The best combination mode of different English language features is obtained after obtaining related parameters by means of direct maximum entropy model training, so as to resolve the problem of part of structural ambiguity in the massive English language, and improve the accuracy of English machine translation. The experimental results show that the designed English machine translation model has high translation accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Quantum Dots Tracking with N-Memory Cluster Indexed SMC-PHD filter
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A Cluster-Indexed SMC-PHD filter was presented to track quantum dots for certain biological purpose. It committed track association by labeling targets with track numbers. One problem of it is the labels of targets shift often when dealing with unsteady targets. The label shifting made it hard to obtain longterm tracks. A novel N-memory Cluster-Indexed SMC-PHD filter was proposed to control the sensitivity to targets birth and death. It checked the tracks back N time intervals to find out if any one of them could be associated with the currently emerging targets, and thereby, rejected false detection alarm resulting from the go-and-back of unsteady targets. Results show the method successfully track quantum dots of high dynamics.

articleTitle: Research on Wood Panel Recognition Based on Digital Visual Features
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the industries of wood furniture and wood floor manufacturing, the color and texture of wood panel are important surface feature parameters. At present, the comprehensive measurement visual feature above-mentioned of wood panel mainly relies on manual visual inspection, which is greatly influenced by human factors, slow in measurement speed and low in accuracy. In this paper, color histogram and gray level co-occurrence matrix are used to digitize the visual features of wood panel, and a parameter system suitable for describing the visual features of wood panel is established. Using by the visual feature parameters system Vnew of wood panel, the recognition rate of BP neural network classifier is up to 95.25%, and the results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Distance Education Management System Considering Load Balancing Strategy of Distributed Crawler System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the features of the load balancing strategy of the distributed crawler system, the functional structure of the distance education management system is analyzed. The key technologies and main database structure of the system based on the load balancing strategy of the distributed crawler system are expounded. In the specific implementation process, the design pattern of the business proxy layer based on the load balancing strategy of the distributed crawler system is introduced. The data interaction strategy among the business proxy layer, presentation layer, and business logic middle layer, as well as the effect of the business proxy model, are elaborated. The application of distance education management system in practical implementation is discussed.

Author Keywords: Load Balancing Strategy of the Distributed Crawler System

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Collision Module in Virtual Reality Scene
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The core problem of collision detection is the intersection of virtual objects. The most direct algorithm is to detect the position between two objects in the scene. However, due to the complexity of the virtual reality scene, this most direct detection algorithm cannot meet the real-time requirements of the role interaction in the virtual reality scene. Therefore, aiming at the collision detection problem in the virtual reality scene, an improved OBB level bounding box algorithm is proposed, which uses the hierarchical construction of the bounding tree to delete the nodes that are not added, and improves the accuracy of collision detection in the scene. Finally, through the performance and function test of the collision module in the system, the result shows that the system has achieved the expected effect, has certain practicability, and has certain reference and reference significance for the collision detection problem.

articleTitle: A solution to electronic license based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The e-license generated by the Internet plus government affairs is an important part of the government's informatization, and the current application faces some problems that cannot be overcome by the existing technology. For example, cross-regional and inter-departmental application processes are complex, applicants and difficult to apply, use, and verify for certificates. Government information communication channels are not smooth. Access rights management is unscientific. Resources are shared and exchanged in real time. Due to complicated processes and data barriers, the public participation is not high. The blockchain as a decentralized centralized technology is undoubtedly the most appropriate choice for solving existing problems.

articleTitle: Research on Classification and Feature Analysis of Weibo Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Suicide is now a social and mental health problem that the world needs to continue to pay attention to, and it has caused significant economic and spiritual losses to society and families. With the rapid development of science and technology and the continuous improvement of people's living standards, the Internet and social platforms have played an increasingly greater role in people's lives, and new ideas have been brought to the solution of this problem. Young people believe that in social networks, they can freely discuss suicide-related topics, and talk about and exchange emotions and feelings related to suicide. At the same time, social platforms are also an effective tool for them to seek help and help others. We use Weibo as a platform to conduct preliminary research on suicide ideation cause extraction, and build a classification-based suicide ideation cause extraction model that combines content feature, context feature, part-of-speech feature, grammatical feature, emotional feature, and language feature. Experiments show that word feature (words, word vectors) perform better than other feature in various evaluation indicators, indicating that word feature can effectively reflect the content of Weibo.

articleTitle: Application of Data Processing Software in logistics economy relevance—— A Case Study of Heyuan City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Data processing software DPS is widely used in various fields of natural sciences and social sciences. In this paper, taking Heyuan City in underdeveloped areas as an example, the influence of the development of regional logistics on the growth of regional economy in Heyuan City is analyzed by using the method of grey correlation analysis. According to the analysis results, the development of regional logistics industry and the development of regional economy show a significant positive correlation, which promotes and cooperates with each other.

articleTitle: Research on Allowable E-field Strength and Insulation Structure Design of Bushing Outlet Device of Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Allowable field strength of the outgoing line device at tail of converter transformer under various operating conditions is analyzed. Then, finite element simulation calculation model of the typical outgoing line structure is established, and the distribution characteristics of the transient potential electric field of the outgoing line device are discussed under the various voltage types such as polarity reversal. This paper proposed iterative calculation method of steady-state E-field and thermal simulation of transformer outlet based on the ANSYS specific language called APDL. The insulation margin value of the critical path is obtained by combining the allowable field strength. The research on the allowable field strength and the insulation structure of the outgoing line device proposed in this paper can provide reference for the design of the outgoing line structure of the converter transformer.

articleTitle: Neural Network Model Of Message Passing in Team Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The football match is so wonderful that every moment on the pitch touch the hearts of the spectators. What if two players are in contact on the pitch? To this end, we will build a neural network model to more intuitively reflect the players' interactions in the game by observing the small interactions between the players in the team, thus can more clearly reflect the entire competition condition. The model can model dynamic information as the graph develops. In particular, the proposed framework can update the node information by continuously capturing the sequential information of edges, the time interval between edges, and the information propagation. Experimental results on various dynamic graphs demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: A Solution to Neural Message Passing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Because of the learning process of the messaging neural network from the inside out, it can explain a game almost perfectly, from the micro to the macro. We need to feed it a certain amount of data. We set a half court as the unit for our AI. Every machine, even AI, is born to work. After our message passing neural network has learned to recurse and reasoning, it is time to get to work. With trained AI, we can explore unknown data spaces. All we need to do is to change the location properties of a few nodes on the input multidimensional graph. We change the structural strategy of all the data sample graph, then we can calculate the average performance indicators of this structural strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Evolutionary Game of Information Transfer Based on Supply-Hub in Supply Chain. Part II: Operator Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: As a new mode of supply chain operation, Supply-Hub has been widely adopted. However, due to the imperfect operating mechanism and the weak willingness of the enterprises to collaborate on information, there are still great problems in information sharing. Information collaboration has become a problem in supply chain management. Based on the perspective of Supply-Hub operator, our work builds an evolutionary game model of operator and node enterprise strategy selection in the supply chain, and then uses MATLAB software simulation to analyze the strategy selection schemes and evolution trends of both parties in different revenue environments. The results show that the strategic choice of supply chain node enterprises is closely related to the cost-benefit ratio, and Supply-Hub operators can use incentives to enhance the willingness of supply chain enterprises to transfer information.

articleTitle: Similarities and Differences of Overspeed Protection Shutdown of Two Thermal Power Units
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Two thermal power units was shutdown due to the wrong action of the overspeed protection. This paper describes the tripping process of two units with different overspeed protection configuration, analyzes the tripping reasons, and gives the correct overspeed protection configuration. The handling and preventive measures can be used for reference to other similar overspeed protection configuration.

articleTitle: Construction and weighting of investment risk index system of general aviation industry based on entropy method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: General aviation industry has great development potential in China. In recent years, general aviation industry has been widely valued by all walks of life due to its high industrial relevance. However, the investment risk of general aviation industry cannot be accurately estimated due to its large investment intensity and long effective time. So how to accurately measure the general aviation industry decision-making and implementation risk? In this paper, the risk measurement index system was constructed firstly, and then the combination weighting model is established by using entropy method, and the combination of the index system of the general aviation industry investment risk index is established.

articleTitle: Research on Discernment of Rectangular Controls in Human-Machine Interactive Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: For the problem of automatic discernment of controls in human-machine interaction interface, the detection and classification methods of controls based on image processing and machine learning are studied. Firstly, image processing algorithm is used to obtain a series of proposal rectangle boxes for human-machine interaction interface. Then, by using the label image in the control, the control category can be identified by machine learning algorithm. In this paper, a data set containing 19 types of control label image is produced, and CNN methods are used to classify them. The experimental results show that the proposal rectangle boxes in the human-machine interactive interface can be captured effectively by combining the image morphology processing algorithm. The rectangular controls can be filtered out by using the label image in the control. The discernment accuracy of CNN model based on VGG16 on verification set can reach more than 97%.

articleTitle: Research and design of the cleaning and disinfecting vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In view of the problem of hospitals, schools, small and medium-sized enterprises and institutions of pavement garbage cleaning and disinfection, a design scheme of a small road cleaning and disinfection vehicle which integrates the functions of road cleaning, garbage collection, transportation and disinfection is proposed. Based on STM32F103 as the main controller in the design, combined with hardware and software, through power system, garbage disposal system and sprinkler system can realize the functions of garbage cleaning, transportation and disinfection function. Finally the physical prototype is produced for testing, the actual test shows that the cleaning and disinfection vehicle can clean up the garbage in time in the narrow road or dangerous place and it can be transported to the designated place. The system is safe, stable, simple in structure and low in cost, which can save human resources and reduce labor intensity.

articleTitle: Mn absorbed on the surface of the monolayer of GeSe Sheet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, we, based on the density function theory (DFT), study the structural, electronic and magnetic properties of the monolayer of GeSe sheet by absorbing two Mn atoms in different hollow sites of this sheet. A series variety of magnetic moments have been found with the change of distance between two Mn atoms absorbed at different hollow sites in ferromagnetic(FM) and anti-ferromagnetic(AFM) states. There is a stable magnetic moment, 2u B, in HS3 structure in FM and AFM states. The analysis of spin-resolved electronic structure reveals there exists a long range exchange interaction and zener's double exchange interaction between the two Mn atoms. Finally, the mean field approximation is employed to estimate Curie temperature by different absorbing strategies. The finding reveals that absorbing strategies changes would lead to varied Curie temperature 0k, 7K and 117K.

articleTitle: Maintainability Simulation Modeling Based on Maintenance Flow Chart
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: According to study the maintenance time simulation method based on the maintenance flow block diagram (MFD) model drawn by the maintainability designer in the process of product design and analysis, the composition of maintenance flow block diagram model is analyzed and the maintenance time model based on maintenance flow chart is constructed then the simulation modeling method considering the distribution type of maintenance time is proposed. It provides scientific reference and basis for maintenance decision-making.

articleTitle: Applying Radam Method to improve treatment of Convolutional Neural Network on Banknote Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the denomination recognition of existing convolutional neural network methods, a method which is based on a Radam optimizer and improved LeNet neural network has been proposed to further addressing problems in the accuracy and efficiency of banknote recognition. In order to improve the training efficiency of the system, the method of transfer learning has been used to extract and recognize the stability and accuracy of input data. For denomination pictures of different sizes, the image normalization method is adopted to realize imported standardized neural network data. In order to further improve the robust performance of the system algorithm, data enhancement methods are introduced, including the geometric transformation of the original data, adding noise, brightness, etc. At end the network connects the fully connected layer and the softmax layer to output labels with different denominations. Experiments show that the network meets the system's real-time requirements, and the algorithm has greatly improved the stability and accuracy of RMB denomination recognition with improvement from 95% to 99.97%. The experimental results illustrate that the algorithm structure is very practical.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine Classification Algorithm Based on Relief-F Feature Weighting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing support vector machines only consider the importance of samples and ignore the importance of features on the classification results, this paper proposes a support vector machine method based on Relief-F feature weighting. This method first uses the Relief-F feature weighting algorithm to calculate the weight value of each feature, and then uses the feature weight value to weight the inner product in the support vector machine kernel function. This method effectively avoids the influence of weakly correlated features or uncorrelated features on the support vector machine classification results. Training and verification are performed on the data provided by the UCI public data set; experimental results show that the method can improve the classification accuracy of the classifier, reduce the number of support vectors, and have better robustness and classification ability than traditional SVM.

articleTitle: Research on multi cloud dynamic secure storage technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The arrival of the era of big data poses a higher challenge to the secure storage of data. The growing data needs a large number of storage media to store. In order to solve the security problem of data storage, this paper proposes a method of slicing data blocks, encrypting them separately, and finally storing them on multiple clouds. In order to further improve the reliability of data storage, this paper proposes a multi cloud dynamic storage scheduling strategy and local storage optional configuration scheme. At the same time, this paper uses micro service architecture and decentralization strategy to ensure the availability of services. In order to solve the problem of data storage efficiency, the data De duplication strategy is proposed in the multi cloud backup system, and the idea of reference counting and reference reachability is used in the multi cloud storage system. This paper introduces the prototype implementation of multi cloud dynamic storage system, and finally tests and analyzes the system. The experimental results show that the scheme is feasible and can achieve the expected design goals.

articleTitle: Vehicle collision prediction based on support vector data description
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: At present, most researchers consider that the number of types of collision factors are limited when researching vehicle collision prediction. In addition, most studies are based on two-class or multi-class methods to study and predict vehicle collisions, but few researchers consider applying single-class classification methods to predict vehicle collisions. In this paper, the least squares method is used to select the 12 factors that affect the collision, and the single category classification method is used to predict the vehicle collision. SVDD (Support Vector Domain Description) was used as a model method for the experiments in this article, the factors (such as weather, traffic flow) that affect vehicle collision are used as the input of the model to train a minimum hypersphere. The validation sample set is validated, and the sample points falling within the sphere are the support vectors trained by the model, that is to say, if the (New) samples similar to the training sample set belong to the same class, those falling outside the sphere do not belong to the training sample set. In this paper, one class SVM is used as a comparative experiment. Finally, the experiment shows that SVDD obtains better prediction results, and the accuracy is better than one class SYTI model.

articleTitle: Toward Ambient Assistance: a Spatially-aware Virtual Assistant eNabled by Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Over the past few decades, the overall aging of the population has been unprecedentedly significant. As traditional care-giving methods are expensive financially and emotionally, Ambient-Assisted Living (AAL) appears to be a promising alternative to ensuring the convenience and safety of the elderly. This paper presents SVAN-a Spatially-aware Virtual Assistant eNabled by Object Detection that facilitates its users' lives in household scenarios. With its ability to achieve real-time multi-object classification and localization, SVAN is able to serve as an spatially-aware intelligent assistant to the resident. Designed with the older adults in mind, SVAN could enhance their performance in daily activities, prevent potential harm and injuries, and offer emotional support as a companion. We conducted experiments to evaluate SVAN's performance in different household scenarios, analyzed SVAN's effectiveness based on its accuracy and efficiency, and highlighted methods to further improve the proposed system.

articleTitle: A Sybil Attack Detection Scheme for a Coal Mines Fire Monitory Application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are developing at a rapid speed. It is usually deployed in order to collect some real-time information, such as forest monitoring, coal mine fire monitoring. There have been some researches on the application of wireless sensor network in different fields, which mainly focus on the delay, loss and fusion of data. The security of wireless sensor network is also an important and challenging task, which is also lacking in all previous researched. In this paper, we propose a two-layer detection scheme based on RSSI and residual energy. Firstly, the high energy node uses the RSSI-based method to detect all normal nodes which including Sybil nodes. Then, the nodes which pass the RSSI detection mechanism are further detected by the method that based on the residual energy. After detection, the Sybil node is banned from participating in the following cluster-head election. In the network structure, a hierarchical clustering model is proposed to select cluster heads that based on the square root of residual energy. The cluster heads are responsible for transmitting real-time data packets to the base station. This method has high network lifetime and high detection rate.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Traffic Scheduling Algorithm for Heterogeneous Software-Defined Airborne Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the advancement of information technology, the traffic and scale of airborne networks, especially the military airborne networks, are growing rapidly. How to efficiently schedule the airborne network traffic to improve the bandwidth utilization and meet the quality of service (QoS) needs of different services have become an urgent issue to be addressed. Software-defined networking (SDN) is a new network paradigm, which completely separates the network control plane and data plane, and controls the network logically. With these new features, it is possible for SDN to control network flows with higher efficiency and flexibility. However, existing airborne network equipment does not support the SDN technology, and it is difficult to upgrade the equipment in a short period. Therefore, it becomes necessary to study the traffic scheduling method considering a heterogeneous scenario with the coexistence of SDN airborne nodes and traditional IP-based airborne nodes. This paper puts forward a dynamic traffic scheduling algorithm for heterogeneous software-defined airborne network, which can improve the bandwidth utilization and network transmission efficiency of airborne networks.

articleTitle: Research On the Development Trend of Military Intergenerational Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of microelectronics and information technology, military communication is facing the situation of comprehensive and intergenerational renewal. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as ultra-wideband communication, space laser, quantum communication and software-aware radio will bring about major changes in landbased, sea-based, space-based communications. Under the strong promotion of the next generation network technology and the future mobile communication technology, the military communication equipment will realize the long-distance and large capacity communication of land, sea and air platforms through optical communication. Through intelligent cognitive radio, the efficient utilization of spectrum resources and anti-interference communication will be realized. The future military communication equipment will develop towards channel broadband, communication service integration, and communication function software.

articleTitle: Study on Tea Production Efficiency in Anxi County Based on Low Carbon Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Low-carbon development is the only way to achieve sustainable development of tea. This paper takes the carbon emission and efficiency of tea production in Anxi County as the research object, and explores the ecological development of tea production in Anxi County. First, the carbon emissions from tea production in 2012-2017 were calculated according to the method provided by IPCC, and then the Malmquist index model was constructed to measure the efficiency of the tea industry including undesired output and non-expected output. The results show that the technical access and industrial scale of the tea production area in Anxi County are relatively reasonable, but carbon emissions have a negative impact on efficiency, resulting in a decrease in efficiency. In response to the above conclusions, this paper puts forward corresponding suggestions to help the tea industry in Anxi County achieve low carbon development.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Ship-borne Communication Equipment on FAHP Based ADC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The effectiveness evaluation of ship-borne communication equipment (SCE for short) is studied. The existing methods of equipment effectiveness evaluation are summarized. In view of the fuzziness, uncertainty and difficulty in quantifying the management factors of SCE by probability and statistics method, the overall effectiveness evaluation of SCE is carried out by using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Considering the use characteristics of SCE, Availability Dependability and Capability (ADC for short) method is used to evaluate the service capability index, and the results are integrated into the overall evaluation of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Two case calculations and simulation results are given, and the corresponding decision-making reference is given according to the results.

articleTitle: A Review of Games and Resource Allocation Algorithms Oriented Public Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: It is important to study game algorithms and resource allocation strategies in the security field with the increasing number of unconventional emergencies, complexity and destructiveness. This paper introduces the current research status of game algorithms and resource allocation algorithms in the security field, analyzes the solution algorithms and models involved in detail, and evaluates the existing problems and application values objectively in order to play a certain reference role for similar research. At present, game algorithms in the security field are mainly divided into four categories: noncooperative games, cooperative games, complete information games, and incomplete information games. The most typical noncooperative game is Stackelberg game, Shapley value method is a common model solving algorithm in cooperative game. The complete information game uses the genetic algorithm to solve the event’s Nash equilibrium solution. The incomplete information game uses the Harsanyi transformation to transform the incomplete information into the probability distribution for the solution. Therefore, errors are indispensable when constructing game models. In resource allocation, the DEA model, ant colony algorithm and HTN-based planning method can be improved to improve the emergency capacity and reduce losses.

articleTitle: ACK Broadcast Scheme to Improve Performance for Wake-Up Radio Enabled WSNs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To reduce the propagation delay in wake-up radio wireless sensor networks, we propose to use ACK broadcasting mechanism to improve the propagation efficiency of data frames. This broadcast mechanism can reduce latency when data frames need to be transmitted. At the same time, sensor networks benefit from wake-up mechanism when there is no data transmission, which can greatly reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Web Service Active Defense Mechanism Based on Automated Software Diversity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of limited number and diversity in existing web server software, an active defense mechanism for web services based on automated software diversity is proposed, and the system framework and implementation are introduced. The formula proves that the probability of an attack escape event is low. Security and performance experiments show that the active defense mechanism of web services based on automated software diversity can resist or detect memory error attacks with less overhead, indicating that automated software diversity can effectively improve the security of web services. This verifies its effectiveness and feasibility. Finally, the research prospects and improvement directions are given according to the implementation granularity of automated software diversity and the monitoring granularity of web services.

articleTitle: Pain Points in Tourism and Its 5G-based Intelligent Solution
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Although the construction of smart tourism has aroused a boom, it is still in the early stage of development, and many traditional problems in the tourism industry have not been well solved, as well as some new problems have emerged. The development of 5G provides the basis to realize the ubiquitous high-speed interconnection between people and things as well as between machines and machines, which bring about the opportunities to solve these problems. This paper reviews the development of smart tourism, analyses the pain points existing in current systems. From the perspective of cybernetics, a 5G based intelligent tourism system providing intelligent service centered on "tourist experience" under the consideration of sustainable development of tourism industry is put forward.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Control of Risley Prism Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The research of the Risley prism system in the closed-loop tracking control of the target has always been focused on the difficulties and hotspots of the system. Due to the nonlinear and strong coupling between the prisms of the system, the currently proposed methods require a large amount of nonlinear and strongly coupled solving. In order to avoid a large number of solving tasks, this paper is based on a control model combining deep reinforcement learning based on Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm and Risley prism control system, combined with the decision-making ability of deep reinforcement learning and the ability of deep neural networks to handle huge state space and continuous action space. The experimental results show that the training of the decision network finally achieves closed-loop control of the target, avoiding the task of solving between prisms, and the model has fast convergence speed and high stability.

articleTitle: The Influence of Perception of Group Attitudes and the Relationship with Victims on Bystander’s Behaviors: the Moderating Effect of Relationships with the Victims
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Research Questions: Is there a difference of attitude toward the acceptability of bullying in demographic variables? Do bystanders have a different perception of varied peer groups' attitudes toward bullying? Do the discrepancies in the second question contribute to bystanders' protective behaviors? Is that relation regulated by demographic variables such as ethnic and the relationship between the victims and bystanders? Methods: A survey of 410 elementary, middle and high school students' attitude toward bullying was conducted through the use of questionnaires. The participants reported their attitudes and perceptions of three different peer groups' attitudes about bullying, as well as their behavior responses when they witness a bullying pluralistic ignorance. Results: (1) The participates' attitudes toward the acceptability of bullying are different in demographic variables, such as age, sex, boarders or day students, boarding schools or day schools, but ethnic does not have any clear influence on their attitudes. (2) When asked about their attitudes toward bullying, children perceived their personal attitudes as more pro-social than any peer groups like friends, popular students, common students, which is consistent with pluralistic ignorance theory. (3)Further, misperception of group norms was associated with the students' reports of behavioral responses to bullying: children were more likely to protect the victims with similar perceived attitudes and the same race as themselves. Conclusion: There is difference between different groups on children's Pluralistic Ignorance. Children thought themselves more pro-social than any other groups. Meanwhile, the more intimate the participants and the group were, the more pro-social they perceived the group was (the discrepancy between self and the intimate group was small). Furthermore, there was an association between bystanders' Pluralistic Ignorance and protective behaviors, and it was regulated by some factors of victims.
